[Client-Side Tracking Basics](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508302-how-heatmap-collects-data#h_2a909e6003)

[Need Help?](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508302-how-heatmap-collects-data#h_ae30c6d901)

Heatmap utilizes advanced, asynchronous client-side tracking to collect user and revenue behavior on your website. This explains the core mechanisms behind our tracking methods, architecture and how we turn raw data into actionable insights.

**Client-Side Tracking Basics**
-------------------------------

Heatmap's tracking operates entirely on the client side, meaning all data is captured directly from the user's browser. This approach is lightweight, flexible, and efficient, allowing for seamless integration into your website. Plus, it takes less than 5 minutes!

The key benefits of our tracking approach include:

*   **Real-Time Data Collection**: Data is captured and processed as users interact with your site, enabling up-to-the-minute insights.  
    ​
    
*   **No Website Performance Impact**: Our asynchronous tracking snippets load in the background, ensuring no page rendering delay. [Read this case study](https://www.heatmap.com/blog/heatmap-site-speed)
     here, where we tested over $2m in a test with/without the heatmap snippet and proved zero difference in revenue performance!  
    ​
    
*   **Detailed Interaction Recording**: Every user action - clicks, scrolls, hovers, or views - is tracked with precision, giving you a complete picture of how users engage with your site.
    

This approach enables granular data collection without heavy server-side infrastructure, making Heatmap.com a versatile choice for e-commerce. Because tracking is client-side, data begins only after the snippets are installed and published - earlier sessions aren’t backfilled.

**Data Collection Process**

Heatmap.com can attribute revenue to each element on your website by assigning an anonymous User ID to every user that visits your website. The Header Snippet collects the behavior and interactions, and the Revenue Snippet ties these interactions to know if users purchased, how much, when, or if they did not purchase at all.

Heatmap.com _does not_ collect personally identifiable information (PII), so it remains 100% compliant in any region worldwide. As it operates on anonymous User IDs, we can track behavior, revenue, and any metric related to a website interaction.

**How Revenue is Tied to Elements**

Because Heatmap.com’s User ID follows the visitor throughout the session, it knows where the user clicked, scrolled, or viewed and ties it to the revenue associated with that session.

The amount of revenue driven by an individual element is calculated using an _aggregate model._ The aggregate model combines the data from all users who clicked on an element and calculates them together.

The _aggregate model_ does not give different “weights” or “contributions” based on different elements, as every element should be treated the same. This also means that revenue is attributed regardless of when in their sessions they interacted with specific elements in their session.

This also enables you to make cohorts (called _Filters_ in-platform) per element, ranging from new vs returning users, traffic sources, purchasers vs non-purchasers, and an infinite number of custom filters you can build.

[Read this article](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10022235-understanding-revenue-heatmaps-visualizing-your-profit-centers)
 to learn more about each Calculated Metric per element inside heatmaps and recordings.

**Need Help?**
--------------

If you have questions or run into any issues while using Heatmap, our support team is here to help. Contact us anytime at [Support@heatmap.com](mailto:Support@heatmap.com)
.

# General Troubleshooting Guide | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#main-content)

General Troubleshooting Guide
=============================

Updated this week

Table of contents

[No Revenue Data in Heatmaps](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#h_f54ba3894e)

[No Clicks on Heatmaps](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#h_59e7535a07)

[Subdomains Not Tracking](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#h_355d53c3fc)

[Installing Header Snippet on a Subdomain](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#h_0abc9cc853)

[Need Help?](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508239-general-troubleshooting-guide#h_97c21a7621)

If you're encountering issues with Heatmap.com tracking, this guide outlines common causes and solutions. For persistent issues, contact us at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
.

A majority of issues reported are due to inaccurate script installation. To ensure that your scripts are installed correctly, reference our [Installation Guides](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/collections/13751320-getting-started-installation)
.

**No Revenue Data in Heatmaps**
-------------------------------

If revenue data is not recording, it's likely that your main tracking snippet is working, but the heatmap pixel for revenue tracking is not active.

*   **Verify Snippet Installation:** In your Settings Portal, check to see if the snippet is installed correctly. (Go to Settings > Snippets > Click on "Verify My Snippet")
    
*   **Verify Event Tracking:** Ensure that purchase events are correctly firing in your analytics setup.  
    ​
    
*   **Check Revenue Attribution**: Confirm that revenue is being assigned per element based on user interactions.  
    ​
    
*   **Inspect JavaScript Errors**: Go to the **order confirmation page** and open your browser’s developer tools (**press F12**, then click **"Console"**). Look for any error messages that might be preventing data from being captured from the Heatmap script. In some cases, other scripts on the checkout or confirmation page can conflict with the Heatmap script and prevent it from loading properly.  
    ​
    
*   **Clear Cache & Complete a Test Order**: Make a test purchase after clearing cache and verify if revenue data is being captured.  
    ​
    

* * *

**No Clicks on Heatmaps**
-------------------------

*   **Verify Snippet Installation:** In your Settings Portal, check to see if the snippet is installed correctly. (Go to Settings > Snippets > Click on "Verify My Snippet")  
    ​
    
*   **Check Element Visibility**: Hidden or dynamically loaded elements may not register clicks.  
    ​
    
*   **Inspect Clickable Areas**: If elements have overlays or JavaScript handlers, clicks may not be recorded.  
    ​
    
*   **Test on Different Devices/Browsers**: Some interactions may behave differently depending on the setup.  
    ​
    

* * *

  
**Page Not Being Tracked**
-----------------------------

*   **Ensure Heatmap Snippet is Installed**: Verify that the tracking code is correctly placed in the <head> section. You can also visit your Settings Portal to check to see if the snippet is installed correctly. (Go to Settings > Snippets > Click on "Verify My Snippet")
    
    *   Note: If you are using a 3rd party page builder, you will need to install the Heatmap script separately on that page. Reference our installation guide [here](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10516928-installing-heatmap-com-on-shopify-page-builders)
        .  
        ​
        
    
*   **Check URL Matching Rules**: Confirm that the page URL follows the expected structure.  
    ​
    
*   **Look for JavaScript Errors**: Open your browser’s developer tools (**press F12**, then click **"Console"**). Look for any error messages that might be preventing data from being captured from the Heatmap script.  
    ​
    
*   **Validate with a Test Visit**: Open the page in an incognito window and see if it registers in the analytics dashboard.  
    ​
    

* * *

  
**Subdomains Not Tracking**
------------------------------

*   **Confirm Cross-Domain Tracking is Enabled**: Heatmap.com settings should allow subdomain tracking.  
    ​
    
*   **Check Cookie Settings**: Ensure cookies are set with the proper domain scope (e.g., .yourdomain.com instead of [www.yourdomain.com](http://www.yourdomain.com/)
    ).  
    ​
    
*   **Verify Script Installation**: The tracking snippet must be installed separately on subdomains.  
    ​
    

* * *

  
**Installing Header Snippet on a Subdomain**
-----------------------------------------------

*   **Manually Add the Script**: Copy and paste the Heatmap.com tracking snippet into the <head> section of the subdomain.  
    ​
    
*   **Use a Tag Manager**: If applicable, deploy the snippet via Google Tag Manager with a rule targeting the subdomain.  
    ​
    
*   **Ensure Proper Permissions**: Some CMS platforms require additional permissions to modify header code.  
    ​
    
*   **Test with Real-Time Tracking**: Visit the subdomain and check if Heatmap.com registers activity.  
    ​
    

* * *

**Need Help?**
--------------

If you have questions or run into any issues while using Heatmap, our support team is here to help. Contact us anytime at [Support@heatmap.com](mailto:Support@heatmap.com)
.

# Allow Heatmap Analytics through Cloudflare | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/14110801-allow-heatmap-analytics-through-cloudflare#main-content)

Allow Heatmap Analytics through Cloudflare
==========================================

Whitelisting our service lets us render your site accurately. Setup takes under 2 minutes.

April 23, 2026

* * *

**Why you need to do this**

To generate heatmaps and session recordings, we fetch your site through our proxy servers — the same way your visitors' browsers do. Cloudflare's **Bot Fight Mode** is designed to block automated requests, which means it can block ours too.

When that happens, renders come back incomplete or blank, and your analytics data becomes unreliable.

⚠️ **Common mistake:** Creating a WAF Custom Rule to "Skip" our traffic does **not** work. Bot Fight Mode runs _before_ WAF rules are evaluated, so the Skip action never reaches our requests.

**The only approach that works:** Use an **IP Access Rule (Allow)** — this is evaluated first in Cloudflare's pipeline and exempts our IP before Bot Fight Mode can block it.

* * *

**How to set it up (2 steps)**

**Step 1 — Go to IP Access Rules**

In your Cloudflare dashboard, navigate to: **Security › WAF › Tools › IP Access Rules**

Make sure you're in the correct zone (your website's domain).

**Step 2 — Create the Allow rule**

Click **Create rule** and fill in the fields exactly as shown:

*   **IP Address:** `166.117.54.25` / `35.71.148.26` / `16.147.25.198` / `44.225.101.246`
    
*   **Action:** Allow
    
*   **Notes:** Heatmap Analytics Proxy
    
*   **Zone:** This website
    

✅ The rule takes effect within **60 seconds**. No page reload or cache purge needed.

* * *

**How to verify it worked**

Go to **Security → Events** in your Cloudflare dashboard. Filter by your domain and check recent entries. Requests from our proxy IP should show the action **Allow**, not Block or Challenge.

If you still see **Bot Fight Mode** listed as the blocking service, the rule wasn't saved correctly or the IP was entered wrong.

* * *

**Frequently asked questions**

**I created a WAF Custom Rule to allow your hostname — why isn't it working?** WAF Custom Rules run _after_ Bot Fight Mode in Cloudflare's pipeline. By the time your rule is evaluated, our request is already blocked. The IP Access Rule runs first — that's why it's the only method that works.

**Can I use a Page Rule to disable security for your traffic?** No. Page Rules with "Disable Security" cannot bypass Bot Fight Mode or Super Bot Fight Mode — this is confirmed by Cloudflare's own documentation.

**Does this work on the free Cloudflare plan?** Yes. IP Access Rules are available on all plans including Free. Free and Pro plans support up to 10,000 rules, so adding one is no problem.

**Will allowing your IP affect my site's security?** Only traffic from our specific proxy IP is affected — no other visitors or bots are exempted. If you ever need to revoke access, simply delete the rule and our proxy will be subject to standard security checks again.

**What if your proxy IP changes?** Our proxy uses static, dedicated IPs that don't change during normal operations. If we ever need to update them, we'll notify you by email at least 7 days in advance.

**How do I know if Bot Fight Mode is what's blocking you?** Go to **Security → Events**, filter by our proxy IP, and look for entries with **"Bot Fight Mode"** listed as the service. That confirms it's the culprit.

**Can you get Cloudflare to whitelist Heatmap Analytics globally?** We're pursuing Cloudflare's verified bots program, which would whitelist our service network-wide. It requires a lengthy approval process. The IP Access Rule is the reliable, immediate solution in the meantime.

**I have multiple Cloudflare zones — do I need to add the rule to each one?** Not necessarily. When creating the rule, you can scope it to **"All websites in account"** to cover all your Cloudflare zones at once. We recommend this if Heatmap Analytics is tracking multiple domains under the same account.

* * *

Need help? Contact us at **[support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
** and we'll walk you through it.

How to Optimize Your Footer
===========================

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/8392951-how-to-optimize-your-footer#h_c4d184abcd)

Every website has a footer. It's a non-negotiable, right?

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834458653/469e9d8da834957b8e6fc795/giphy.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=3375a78ba12fa52a9edfb926008404e08509c5a7a6522c8841297ab2ad31fa9e&req=fCMjEsx2m4RcFb4f3HP0gNYEW%2F1%2Bb3MKya5aqtb1c0%2BoDs59rVAlbX4N0PMW%0AdWlhF30%2FlQDh7tN6wQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834458653/469e9d8da834957b8e6fc795/giphy.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=3375a78ba12fa52a9edfb926008404e08509c5a7a6522c8841297ab2ad31fa9e&req=fCMjEsx2m4RcFb4f3HP0gNYEW%2F1%2Bb3MKya5aqtb1c0%2BoDs59rVAlbX4N0PMW%0AdWlhF30%2FlQDh7tN6wQ%3D%3D%0A)

Let us show you how you would optimize your footer while using heatmap.com.

Here's a video for you 👇if you want more detail keep scrolling.

Three Ways to Optimize Footers using Heatmap.com
================================================

1.  Prioritize elements in the footer that generate high revenue per click or session.
    
2.  Rearrange and de-prioritize elements that are not performing well.
    
3.  Consider rewriting footer content to improve conversion and engagement.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834461852/e2ed0ce1d3c74ad40e0e5422/CleanShot+2023-09-19+at+16.24.42%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1e39c6f735b7df3817c7b40569cc6ca173472410ac21fdc3abfead5a739edf10&req=fCMjEs9%2FlYRdFb4f3HP0gMTcwxY6Psle%2F5tbJtS1WJ4k0u1h30ZwcvDEWNza%0AXjCbIzRQm10zxKljew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834461852/e2ed0ce1d3c74ad40e0e5422/CleanShot+2023-09-19+at+16.24.42%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1e39c6f735b7df3817c7b40569cc6ca173472410ac21fdc3abfead5a739edf10&req=fCMjEs9%2FlYRdFb4f3HP0gMTcwxY6Psle%2F5tbJtS1WJ4k0u1h30ZwcvDEWNza%0AXjCbIzRQm10zxKljew%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834462823/17bae1d3079c8b104f45ebf8/CleanShot+2023-09-19+at+16.27.36%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=e29d3b8e6dfe997ffae7180b097fdcc8c566b5b7f3652bdf297c5e61f1132c04&req=fCMjEs98lYNcFb4f3HP0gJJ1s%2FpTLxct3MaR35RvMnJR5rJpIHY%2F9Uw%2BoCEo%0Axb7vAoPQcbqbEmxwMw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/834462823/17bae1d3079c8b104f45ebf8/CleanShot+2023-09-19+at+16.27.36%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=e29d3b8e6dfe997ffae7180b097fdcc8c566b5b7f3652bdf297c5e61f1132c04&req=fCMjEs98lYNcFb4f3HP0gJJ1s%2FpTLxct3MaR35RvMnJR5rJpIHY%2F9Uw%2BoCEo%0Axb7vAoPQcbqbEmxwMw%3D%3D%0A)

*   Examine specific elements in a footer, such as "About Us," "Careers," and various product categories.
    
*   Removing or optimize elements that do not contribute to clicks or sales -> for instance on the above example - Facebook + Pinterest icons aren't driving any clicks at all - you could remove them or add a different social media platform.
    
*   **Prioritize the elements that generate revenue. (See image #2)**
    
*   If elements of your footer are needed but aren't driving any sort of interaction, rewrite the title or find a new way to communicate why customers should click. (example in the video)
    

Your footer will always be there, but what will it do for your business. It's a small percentage but one that could lift your whole business up. Don't forget about it!

======================================

This article transparently outlines how Heatmap calculates each key and core metric, specifically highlighting what's included or excluded, and clarifying why Heatmap data intentionally differs from platforms like Shopify or Google Analytics.

Dive deeper into how Heatmap's data compares to Shopify. [Click here to learn more](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-heatmap-vs-shopify-why-the-numbers-are-different-hint-we-did-it-on-purpose)
.

**Heatmap Data Definitions**
============================

Here’s how we define each metric specifically designed for ecommerce growth:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | **Definition** |
| [Engaged Session](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_eb2ac3b1ab)<br> (Sessions) | A session only counts as engaged if the visitor clicks on the page (any element), scrolls down at least once, and/or remains on the page for at least 5 seconds |
| [Website Revenue](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_06e4cc01c3) | Captured revenue from completed purchases at the exact moment the visitor hits the "Thank You" page. |
| [Website Conversion Rate](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_ac83e7b521) | Percentage of engaged sessions that result in a purchase.<br><br>[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559492124/6abaf8a1b1416e8ce871d1f035e8/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_03_51%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=79ecb7398a5849ab17bcab4c0b876380efe05f88385ddf80849b542c412c2e0c&req=dSUiH813n4BdXfMW1HO4zYQ2mip2MV2zhyWmxcGAaDGYHiJVLrTaI1igRIxa%0AcB2F%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559492124/6abaf8a1b1416e8ce871d1f035e8/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_03_51%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=79ecb7398a5849ab17bcab4c0b876380efe05f88385ddf80849b542c412c2e0c&req=dSUiH813n4BdXfMW1HO4zYQ2mip2MV2zhyWmxcGAaDGYHiJVLrTaI1igRIxa%0AcB2F%0A) |
| [Revenue per Session (RPS)](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_62fdcb6eff) | Revenue generated per engaged session.<br><br>[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559495334/23b05ae96a012c56504f76d387ed/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_04_15%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1e0c4e620cce51aa62debbeac91527726c6a683ceaaa511162042c54889c61d7&req=dSUiH813mIJcXfMW1HO4zVldKKryyrRXbs3onoVjnBN8pwRCJBA96m0hTgkT%0AEMbA%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559495334/23b05ae96a012c56504f76d387ed/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_04_15%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1e0c4e620cce51aa62debbeac91527726c6a683ceaaa511162042c54889c61d7&req=dSUiH813mIJcXfMW1HO4zVldKKryyrRXbs3onoVjnBN8pwRCJBA96m0hTgkT%0AEMbA%0A) |
| [Website Average Order Value (AOV)](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_9484ca4954) | Average amount spent per order at checkout, including shipping and taxes.<br><br>[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559495633/cc3e3b81007ecdaf7a1c37df5516/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_04_19%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=c74c1dfe7b6bdd959c8ec087f4e6409814024f046d43864405a314552c135237&req=dSUiH813mIdcWvMW1HO4zVEbF71J9jiYuijMqljIq8ZbAUaUr7ajGfUQD599%0Ai65h%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559495633/cc3e3b81007ecdaf7a1c37df5516/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+2_04_19%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=c74c1dfe7b6bdd959c8ec087f4e6409814024f046d43864405a314552c135237&req=dSUiH813mIdcWvMW1HO4zVEbF71J9jiYuijMqljIq8ZbAUaUr7ajGfUQD599%0Ai65h%0A) |
| [Pageview](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_09e8ef573b) | Counts each individual page visited within an engaged session. |
| [Add to Cart](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_4667aa5055) | Counts sessions where a visitor clicks Add to Cart (ATC) at least once. |
| [Begin Checkout](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_11a72553a6) | Counts sessions that reach the checkout payment page after a session begins on a web page. |
| [Transactions (Purchase)](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology#h_3acdcd18f5) | Counts completed purchases where the visitor reaches the "Thank You" page. |

* * *

**Understanding How Our Data is Defined**
=========================================

**1\. Engaged Sessions**
------------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

A session only counts as engaged if the visitor meets at least one of these criteria:

*   Clicks on the page (any element)
    
*   Scrolls down at least once
    
*   Remains on the page for **at least 5 seconds  
    ​**
    

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Instant bounces (sessions <5 seconds with no interaction)
    
*   Bots, crawlers, spam traffic
    
*   Sessions with no detectable engagement  
    ​
    

### **Shopify vs Heatmap:**

*   Shopify includes all sessions, quick visits, non-loaded page sessions, and bot traffic. Heatmap only collects engaged, human sessions with intent to purchase
    

### **Example:**

*   User A lands, scrolls immediately → **Engaged Session ✅**
    
*   User B lands, exits in 3 seconds, no clicks/scroll → **Not counted ❌**
    

**2\. Website Revenue**
-----------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Captured revenue from completed purchases at the exact moment the visitor hits the "Thank You" page.

### **What's Included:**

*   Product price
    
*   Shipping costs
    
*   Taxes collected at checkout
    

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Refunds and returns after purchase
    
*   Order edits after checkout
    
*   Subscription renewals (automatic recurring charges)
    

### **Shopify vs Heatmap:**

*   Shopify includes post-purchase refunds, adjustments, and revenue from non-website channels (Shop App, Mobile Apps, Subscriptions, TikTok/Instagram Shop, etc.).
    

### **Example:**

*   Customer pays $100 for products + $10 shipping + $5 tax = **$115 total revenue**
    
*   Heatmap records revenue as **$115** at purchase completion.  
    ​  
    ​
    

**3\. Website Conversion Rate**
-------------------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Only includes **engaged sessions** that result in purchases.

### **Formula:**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559500590/2c1d3784c27ca7aadaa3d920ba52/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_03_51-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=5348c8ee71a9ddd19a2d55aedfa0a311e5d389420a53fe71810016c88f2e68e7&req=dSUiH8x%2BnYRWWfMW1HO4zVBfL50%2B1Wgn6yvLAhFakeNLOGbrZA6w86AiLhe%2F%0AX%2F46aLNPUbubGjBwK%2BI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559500590/2c1d3784c27ca7aadaa3d920ba52/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_03_51-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=5348c8ee71a9ddd19a2d55aedfa0a311e5d389420a53fe71810016c88f2e68e7&req=dSUiH8x%2BnYRWWfMW1HO4zVBfL50%2B1Wgn6yvLAhFakeNLOGbrZA6w86AiLhe%2F%0AX%2F46aLNPUbubGjBwK%2BI%3D%0A)

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Purchases from non-engaged sessions (sessions without a click, scroll, or stay less than 5 seconds)
    

### **Shopify vs Heatmap:**

*   Shopify counts all sessions, including unengaged traffic, therefore typically showing a lower conversion rate than Heatmap will. This is due to Heatmap restricting the definition of an Engaged Session with the same number of purchases. _This makes your Heatmap Website Conversion Rate more actionable for website optimization_
    

**TLDR:** Shopify includes all sessions, engaged or not, resulting in a lower and less actionable conversion rate.

### **Example:**

*   1,000 Engaged Sessions, 50 orders → Conversion Rate = **(50 ÷ 1,000) × 100 = 5%  
    ​  
    ​**
    

**4\. Revenue per Session (RPS)**
---------------------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Measures revenue per engaged session only.

### **Formula:**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559500854/8bab4b4ab0c675cf452dc83b0f0b/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_04_15-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=c4b997524a600f2d7501d0c743de801cf852e629442f0b2c53d7c99c2a0a9b7c&req=dSUiH8x%2BnYlaXfMW1HO4zZPXlM%2FnHOP8gTytHpGDxBjPQ60vRu0R9KHgaye4%0AIrVBFFQVkeNsJhhlLaI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559500854/8bab4b4ab0c675cf452dc83b0f0b/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_04_15-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=c4b997524a600f2d7501d0c743de801cf852e629442f0b2c53d7c99c2a0a9b7c&req=dSUiH8x%2BnYlaXfMW1HO4zZPXlM%2FnHOP8gTytHpGDxBjPQ60vRu0R9KHgaye4%0AIrVBFFQVkeNsJhhlLaI%3D%0A)

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Unengaged sessions (no interactions or less than 5 seconds)  
    ​
    

### **Shopify vs Heatmap:**

*   Shopify uses all sessions (passive sessions, instant bounces, mixing low or no-intent traffic, etc), resulting in a lower RPS metric compared to Heatmap.  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   Revenue: $5,000, Engaged Sessions: 1,000 → **RPS = $5,000 ÷ 1,000 = $5.00  
    ​  
    ​**
    

**5\. Website Average Order Value (AOV)**
-----------------------------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Measures total spent per order at checkout, including taxes and shipping.

### **Formula:**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559501104/526975bfb003ba41db25a8466f9a/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_04_19-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=dfe5e15560e4301576ed5db0e7f0acb7ee18798fecc30551c26d93a23911a70f&req=dSUiH8x%2BnIBfXfMW1HO4zTIlGpJqqjO5Hss8i9FODg9tCTyKSEuF%2FzBO11cJ%0AkgLb3xIUWRZjrfMHbkg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559501104/526975bfb003ba41db25a8466f9a/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B2_04_19-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=dfe5e15560e4301576ed5db0e7f0acb7ee18798fecc30551c26d93a23911a70f&req=dSUiH8x%2BnIBfXfMW1HO4zTIlGpJqqjO5Hss8i9FODg9tCTyKSEuF%2FzBO11cJ%0AkgLb3xIUWRZjrfMHbkg%3D%0A)

### **What's Included:**

*   Total revenue spent per purchase. This includes product price, taxes, shipping, which is the true amount of revenue collected per transaction.  
    ​
    

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Returns, refunds
    
*   Recurring subscription charges post-initial purchase
    
*   Off-website transactions
    

### **Shopify Difference:**

*   Shopify excludes taxes/shipping and factors in returns/refunds, typically reporting a “lower AOV.” It’s important to note that AOV of transactions off-website (Shop App, TikTok Shop, etc) often have a lower AOV than website purchases.  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   Customer purchases a $50 product, $5 shipping, $3 tax = **Heatmap AOV: $58**
    
*   Shopify would report **$50 AOV** (excluding shipping and tax).  
    ​  
    ​
    

**6\. Pageviews**
-----------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Counts each individual page visited within an engaged session.

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Pageviews during passive, unengaged sessions (no click, no scroll, <5 sec duration)  
    ​
    

### **Shopify Difference:**

*   Shopify counts all pageviews, including from passive or accidental sessions.  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   User visits homepage (10 sec), clicks to product page → **2 pageviews ✅**
    
*   User quickly clicks and immediately exits (<5 sec, no click) → **0 pageviews ❌  
    ​  
    ​**
    

**7\. Add to Cart**
-------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Counts **sessions** where a visitor clicks Add to Cart (ATC) at least once. This is session-based counting, meaning heatmap counts Add to Carts as “did this session Add to Cart or not.” If yes, you will see one ATC in your dashboard.

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Multiple Add-to-Cart clicks within the same session (session-based reporting)
    
*   Sessions without engagement  
    ​
    

### **Shopify vs Heatmap:**

*   Shopify reports sessions where Add to Cart occurred, but doesn't differentiate multiple ATCs within one session explicitly. Their documentation **does not disclose this,** while Heatmap’s does.  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   User clicks Add-to-Cart three times in same session → counted as **1 Add to Cart**  
    ​  
    ​
    

**8\. Begin Checkout**
----------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Counts sessions that reach the checkout payment page after a session begins on a web page. **Very important,** if a user lands in Checkout as their entry page, Heatmap does not record this as a true Begin Checkout.

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Sessions that begin directly on checkout (direct links, email checkout links, external shops like TikTok Shop, etc)  
    ​
    

### **Shopify Difference:**

*   Shopify counts all sessions reaching checkout, including direct-to-checkout sessions.  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   User browses products, proceeds to checkout page → **Counted ✅**
    
*   User lands directly on checkout from external link → **Not counted ❌  
    ​**
    

**9\. Transaction (Purchase)**
------------------------------

### **How Heatmap Calculates:**

Counts completed purchases where the visitor reaches the "Thank You" page.

### **What's Excluded:**

*   Incomplete Thank You page load (never reached the Thank You page or instant bounce from Thank You page)
    
*   Purchases starting directly at checkout (without prior browsing session)
    
*   Off-website transactions
    

### **Shopify Difference:**

*   Shopify counts all completed transactions regardless of where the purchase is made​  
    ​
    

### **Example:**

*   User browses site, initiates checkout, hits Thank You page → **Transaction counted ✅**
    
*   User lands directly on checkout, completes purchase → **Not counted ❌**
    
*   User buys from Shop App, not website **→ Not counted ❌  
    ​  
    ​**
    

* * *

**Element-Specific Definitions**
================================

Here’s how we define each element-specific metric with our Heatmaps to understand how often that element plays a role in driving conversions:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | **Definition** |
| Clicks | The total number of clicks associated with an element. |
| Purchases | The total number of purchases associated with an element. |
| Revenue | The total revenue generated from all purchases linked to a particular element. |
| Average Order Value (AOV) | The average amount spent per order on the element. |
| Conversion Rate (eCVR) | Percentage of clicks on an element that result in a purchase.<br><br>_\= Element Purchases / Element Clicks_ |
| Revenue per Session (eRPS) | The total revenue from users who viewed a specific element on their screen during a visit to a page.<br><br>_\= Element Revenue / Engaged Page Sessions_ |
| Revenue per Click (eRPC) | The total revenue generated per click on a specific element.<br><br>_\= Element Revenue / Element Clicks_ |

* * *

**Understanding data discrepancies**
====================================

Not all platforms measure traffic the same way and not all data is created equal. That’s by design. While other platforms may log every page load or transaction (bots included), Heatmap filters for intent-driven, high-quality user behavior. This means you get cleaner, more actionable insights focused on what truly matters: optimizing your website for real customers.

👉 Want to learn more how our data compares? Check out:

*   [Heatmap vs Shopify](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-heatmap-vs-shopify-why-the-numbers-are-different-hint-we-did-it-on-purpose)
    
*   Heatmap vs Google Analytics

Whether you’re updating personal details, inviting team members, adjusting your subscription plan, or handling payments and invoices, this guide provides clear, step-by-step instructions and helpful notes. Our goal is to ensure you have all the information you need to manage your Heatmap account with confidence and efficiency.

**Account Management**
======================

**Updating Account Details**
----------------------------

### Update your account information

1.  Log in to your Heatmap account using your registered email and password.
    
2.  From the dashboard, click your account name in the lower left corner.
    
3.  Select **Profile** (highlighted in green).
    
4.  Under **Settings**, you’ll see tabs for **Account** -> **My Account, Managed Accounts, My Team Members**, etc.
    
    **My Account** lets you update:
    
    *   Full name
        
    *   Username
        
    *   Email address
        
    *   Phone number
        
    *   Billing address
        
    
5.  After making changes, click **Update**. You’ll see a success message confirming your update.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1708018863/aa30a5449672055bf61144b5a9b5/b7a931dd-724f-4a9f-8818-728b773617c0?expires=1789486200&signature=234c940108f06e58f9147c00192e9bcf0f6f2be8dc80d03a4e32b100fb143795&req=dScnHsl%2FlYlZWvMW1HO4zWrUoIQgA14HZ%2F2i2%2FF%2B2z76tQK%2FSktxSuQmrlv3%0AkqQtSLq4dYoewtnpvtw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1708018863/aa30a5449672055bf61144b5a9b5/b7a931dd-724f-4a9f-8818-728b773617c0?expires=1789486200&signature=234c940108f06e58f9147c00192e9bcf0f6f2be8dc80d03a4e32b100fb143795&req=dScnHsl%2FlYlZWvMW1HO4zWrUoIQgA14HZ%2F2i2%2FF%2B2z76tQK%2FSktxSuQmrlv3%0AkqQtSLq4dYoewtnpvtw%3D%0A)

### Change Your Password

1.  Go to the **My Account** tab and select **Change Password**.
    
2.  You’ll receive a verification code (OTP) in your email. Enter this code to initiate the reset process.
    
3.  Enter your new preferred password, then enter it again to confirm on the second tab
    
4.  Confirm this by clicking ‘Reset Password’ before
    
5.  Once successful, you’ll see a confirmation message.
    

**_Note:_** For extra security, you can enable **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**. This requires both your password and an authenticator app code when logging in.

You can also update company information (such as company name or registered email) under the **Profile Details** section.

**Adding Team Members**
-----------------------

If you’re an agency or account owner, you can invite teammates to your Heatmap workspace.

### Add a new member

1.  Go to **My Team Members** in the **Accounts** menu.
    
2.  Click **Add Team Member**.
    
3.  Enter the teammate’s full name, email address, and an optional message.
    
4.  Choose their access level (Read or Write):
    
    *   **Read**: Can view dashboards and reports only.  
        ​
        
    *   **Write**: Can view and edit data, download invoices, invite other members, etc.  
        ​
        
    
5.  Select which websites they should have access to (useful if you manage multiple sites or clients).
    
6.  Click **Add Member**.
    

The teammate will get an email invitation. Their status will appear as **Pending** until they accept. Once they join, their status changes to **Active**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2043233018/726ee8013268f38a3bd35765fde7/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1d27368d8a92fa52fa2b8e8bbaf23aa710b5f325a20d62ab7a55bfbaf9110cad&req=diAjFct9noFeUfMW1HO4zap797SB7YHPJxqPC%2FoYVbnoPJGO5HBg7z5WTEXj%0A1OR98TqGOWDIXTboHvc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2043233018/726ee8013268f38a3bd35765fde7/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=1d27368d8a92fa52fa2b8e8bbaf23aa710b5f325a20d62ab7a55bfbaf9110cad&req=diAjFct9noFeUfMW1HO4zap797SB7YHPJxqPC%2FoYVbnoPJGO5HBg7z5WTEXj%0A1OR98TqGOWDIXTboHvc%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2043234444/70bd84bcb0a1ce19c1ea20c30fb1/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a8d31655a5b72a43aa1858d0bf85dc85b9feb1b4634cf430253116721259e74a&req=diAjFct9mYVbXfMW1HO4zWBF3x6M4VFl2%2FCvzldMbjsTN1xWUxkcj%2FCoMiP5%0AMzdtLTID3uNRV9Suwm0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2043234444/70bd84bcb0a1ce19c1ea20c30fb1/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a8d31655a5b72a43aa1858d0bf85dc85b9feb1b4634cf430253116721259e74a&req=diAjFct9mYVbXfMW1HO4zWBF3x6M4VFl2%2FCvzldMbjsTN1xWUxkcj%2FCoMiP5%0AMzdtLTID3uNRV9Suwm0%3D%0A)

**Managing & Removing Team Members**
------------------------------------

*   You can see all active and pending invitations under **My Team Members**.  
    ​
    
*   To update a member’s role, click the **Actions** icon, choose the desired team member, and adjust their access permission level.
    
    *   You'll be able to choose either of the following access permission levels:
        
        *   **Read**: Can view dashboards and analytics. Cannot make changes, invite teammates, or view billing details.
            
        *   **Write**: Full access to dashboards, analytics, billing, and ability to manage teammates.  
            ​
            
        
    
*   To remove a teammate, choose **Remove User**. You’ll be asked to confirm, as this action cannot be undone. Once confirmed, the teammate is permanently removed from your workspace.

**Subscription Management**
===========================

**Checking Your Current Plan**
------------------------------

You can view all your subscriptions and their status in one place.

1.  Log in to your Heatmap account.
    
2.  Click **Settings** from the lower-left corner of the dashboard.
    
3.  Select **Subscriptions** (4th option in the Side Menu to your left).
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1708025798/c0d2acc9fc7740e3b79967543f1d/8ddbe5be-88d6-415c-a52d-be78eceac0c0?expires=1789486200&signature=9463c468dc65429604259022187466ff7e94198a3f8e9ef87e94dd7b35d891f0&req=dScnHsl8mIZWUfMW1HO4zVI4LPfq4%2FlIIJYm5nAz3mf%2FvuYC2bQbZgGh10Xp%0AkbFF0G0lVPvZqHLCf7c%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1708025798/c0d2acc9fc7740e3b79967543f1d/8ddbe5be-88d6-415c-a52d-be78eceac0c0?expires=1789486200&signature=9463c468dc65429604259022187466ff7e94198a3f8e9ef87e94dd7b35d891f0&req=dScnHsl8mIZWUfMW1HO4zVI4LPfq4%2FlIIJYm5nAz3mf%2FvuYC2bQbZgGh10Xp%0AkbFF0G0lVPvZqHLCf7c%3D%0A)

Here you’ll see:

*   All your websites, whether active or cancelled.
    
*   **Start date** (when the subscription began).
    
    *   For cancelled sites, the start dates are updated when the cancelled site is reactivated. If a subscription was cancelled and later reactivated, you’ll see the start date of the new subscription.
        
    

**_Note:_** Currently, plan pricing only appears when choosing the Reactivate Subscription button.

**Changing Plans**
------------------

You can adjust your Heatmap subscription at any time.

1.  Go to **Settings > Subscriptions**.
    
2.  Find the site you want to update and click the **Options (⋮)** menu.
    
3.  Select **Change Plan**.
    
4.  A window will show with the option to select the desired plan with your appropriate revenue tier.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271135019/a801c39d8bfb8d2d1b71fee0deae/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=cc986d4bfe77fd89ed5a8d0bf5a827aaa8d846bd124f358e4df325dff11726ca&req=diIgF8h9mIFeUPMW1HO4zekJFLXJGSIU47a0Mv6%2BRPWk74d48ZkneziINwAr%0AvtJC%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271135019/a801c39d8bfb8d2d1b71fee0deae/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=cc986d4bfe77fd89ed5a8d0bf5a827aaa8d846bd124f358e4df325dff11726ca&req=diIgF8h9mIFeUPMW1HO4zekJFLXJGSIU47a0Mv6%2BRPWk74d48ZkneziINwAr%0AvtJC%0A)
    
5.  Choose **Monthly** or **Yearly** billing when the preferred plan has been selected.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271138577/58c5f5e29d5c07a7d62cb9560cf1/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=08d08ca09f5de10f92519867a89a33c541564773202212aa6e4caf0491d1d293&req=diIgF8h9lYRYXvMW1HO4zc9mGm7IYZOw3o%2B1uBOiumLk7dG8xzsfKEHBKWNs%0Ae%2BIA%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271138577/58c5f5e29d5c07a7d62cb9560cf1/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=08d08ca09f5de10f92519867a89a33c541564773202212aa6e4caf0491d1d293&req=diIgF8h9lYRYXvMW1HO4zc9mGm7IYZOw3o%2B1uBOiumLk7dG8xzsfKEHBKWNs%0Ae%2BIA%0A)
    
6.  Confirm the change. You’ll see a success message at the bottom left corner of the screen.  
    ​
    
    **_Note:_** If the dashboard doesn’t update immediately, refresh the page to see the new status.
    

**Cancelling Your Subscription**
--------------------------------

To pause or cancel your Heatmap subscription:

1.  Go to **Settings > Subscriptions**.
    
2.  Find the site you want to cancel, then click the **Options (⋮)** menu under the Actions column.
    
3.  Select **Cancel Plan**.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271140340/36169c11f12d37a9597b8f8ac4c8/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=b9b9cfea670bbc7e21ac96fabf45491bd095b60e113605faba821adaee70c64f&req=diIgF8h6nYJbWfMW1HO4zYgpgR87fW57MJSZUlna%2BG8LDyFgDFJxygnmGLgK%0AyP43%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271140340/36169c11f12d37a9597b8f8ac4c8/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=b9b9cfea670bbc7e21ac96fabf45491bd095b60e113605faba821adaee70c64f&req=diIgF8h6nYJbWfMW1HO4zYgpgR87fW57MJSZUlna%2BG8LDyFgDFJxygnmGLgK%0AyP43%0A)
    
4.  A confirmation message will appear, where you can then click **Confirm Cancellation**.
    
    1.  If you just activated the subscription, cancellation is immediate.
        
    2.  If you’ve been active for a while, you may be asked for feedback prior to confirming your cancellation.
        
    
    After cancellation, you’ll keep access until the end of your billing period or trial, but you won’t be charged again. Even though your subscription might be cancelled, you'll still have access to your data for the duration of time defined by your plan.  
    ​
    

**Reactivating a Subscription**
-------------------------------

You can restart a cancelled subscription anytime.

1.  Go to **Settings > Subscriptions**.
    
2.  Find the cancelled site and click the **Options (⋮)** menu.
    
3.  Select **Reactivate Subscription**.
    
4.  A confirmation window will show your plan name, price, and tier. Click **confirm**.
    
5.  You’ll see a success message once the subscription is active again at the lower left corner.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271152401/062c21874e41ad7506e852fcd6ba/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=48e65e18761629c472eac35c4af53c6fc8dc74d524178ffccaf5260c6c03a73f&req=diIgF8h7n4VfWPMW1HO4za8rTuHq3SbqgEygCz3pJ9e9yoTc9zX3E6m9gZkv%0AwMwK%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2271152401/062c21874e41ad7506e852fcd6ba/image.png?expires=1789486200&signature=48e65e18761629c472eac35c4af53c6fc8dc74d524178ffccaf5260c6c03a73f&req=diIgF8h7n4VfWPMW1HO4za8rTuHq3SbqgEygCz3pJ9e9yoTc9zX3E6m9gZkv%0AwMwK%0A)
    
      
    ​  
    ​**⚠️ Important:** If your site was inactive for a while, the system may assign a new Site ID. Always reinstall the **latest snippet** from your account to ensure tracking works correctly. Even if the Site ID doesn’t change, it’s best practice to copy and reinstall the most up-to-date snippet from Heatmap. This prevents tracking issues due to code updates.
    

* * *

**Billing and Payments**
========================

Adding or Updating Payment Methods
----------------------------------

You can manage your payment methods directly in your Heatmap account.

1.  Log in to your Heatmap account.
    
2.  Go to **Settings** (bottom-left corner of the dashboard).
    
3.  Select **Payments**.
    
4.  Under the **Methods** tab, you’ll see your saved cards.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1715572024/f5e402d2fe9908d826408a6e8237/30637866-9146-40d3-83ed-d756fa81efb8?expires=1789486200&signature=9e6c05f35bc527996cee82f38dacdd029ebc02b6447754519e5f4cafdc22769f&req=dScmE8x5n4FdXfMW1HO4zQo%2BcLcnW8LWAG9R5tkNUs7FsjJ8nqc6L0ASllXv%0A%2BUzYMFQwywr3iB8u9a8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1715572024/f5e402d2fe9908d826408a6e8237/30637866-9146-40d3-83ed-d756fa81efb8?expires=1789486200&signature=9e6c05f35bc527996cee82f38dacdd029ebc02b6447754519e5f4cafdc22769f&req=dScmE8x5n4FdXfMW1HO4zQo%2BcLcnW8LWAG9R5tkNUs7FsjJ8nqc6L0ASllXv%0A%2BUzYMFQwywr3iB8u9a8%3D%0A)

**To Add a New Card**

1.  Click **Add Payment Method**.
    
2.  Enter your card details (Visa, Mastercard, or American Express).
    
3.  If the card is valid, you’ll see a confirmation message.
    
4.  You can tick **Make Default** if you want this card used for all future payments.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1721450302/68ca96519c21dc8805eb97659e17/Screenshot%2B2025-09-11%2Bat%2B1_36_08-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=542e12460ab581c34e566c03cae903015ecaccfad49818c396b3f9d4dc231788&req=dSclF817nYJfW%2FMW1HO4zTCLbVR6VXV7%2FSa8MlPBbWDludpASvk4McUUgBkd%0AzT6n%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1721450302/68ca96519c21dc8805eb97659e17/Screenshot%2B2025-09-11%2Bat%2B1_36_08-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=542e12460ab581c34e566c03cae903015ecaccfad49818c396b3f9d4dc231788&req=dSclF817nYJfW%2FMW1HO4zTCLbVR6VXV7%2FSa8MlPBbWDludpASvk4McUUgBkd%0AzT6n%0A)
    

**To Update a Card**

1.  Find the card under the **Methods** tab.
    
2.  Click **Edit** to update details like expiration date or ZIP code.
    
3.  Save changes. You’ll get a notification confirming the update.
    
4.  If you only have one card, it will automatically be your default.  
    ​
    

**To Remove a Card**

1.  Open the **Edit** menu on the card.
    
2.  Choose **Remove**.  
    ​
    
    Remember: if you only have one card, you must add a new one first before removing it.
    

**Viewing Invoices & Receipts**
-------------------------------

All invoices linked to your subscriptions are available in your account.

1.  Go to **Settings > Payments**.
    
2.  Under the **Payments** tab, you’ll see a list of invoices by date and amount.
    
3.  To get a copy, click **Download** and an invoice will be saved to your device.  
    ​  
    ​**_Note:_** Receipts are not automatically issued through the platform. If you specifically need a receipt, you can request one from Support at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
    .
    

**Checking Payment History**
----------------------------

Your full billing history is shown under the **Payments** tab in Settings.

You’ll see:

*   The date of each transaction.
    
*   The amount charged.
    
*   The subscription linked to the payment.
    

This helps track which websites or plans were billed and when.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1715574593/8681df0468081481996b145c256e/e84c2d82-7dc6-4172-8ab0-8ae6a6a7fb5e?expires=1789486200&signature=b2d3fc9018059a81a2f4896801af42aecb90c07a456e6859f378ac49f598b5f8&req=dScmE8x5mYRWWvMW1HO4zZc%2FzKvaLb%2BoUpHkf3hV%2FGcRtWEncxZxxG1Xvqae%0AbcbFcAEuV7GUNlba9%2Fc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1715574593/8681df0468081481996b145c256e/e84c2d82-7dc6-4172-8ab0-8ae6a6a7fb5e?expires=1789486200&signature=b2d3fc9018059a81a2f4896801af42aecb90c07a456e6859f378ac49f598b5f8&req=dScmE8x5mYRWWvMW1HO4zZc%2FzKvaLb%2BoUpHkf3hV%2FGcRtWEncxZxxG1Xvqae%0AbcbFcAEuV7GUNlba9%2Fc%3D%0A)

**Payment Failures**
--------------------

Payments may fail for several reasons:

1.  The card is invalid.
    
2.  Insufficient funds.
    
3.  The card has been restricted by the bank.  
    ​
    

**What Happens When a Payment Fails**

*   The system will retry charging your card automatically every 2 days.
    
*   It will attempt up to **5 times**.
    
*   If all retries fail, your subscription will be **paused,** and tracking will stop.  
    ​  
    ​**_Note:_** This may look like your Heatmap snippet isn’t working, but often it’s linked to billing. Support can check logs on the backend to confirm if tracking stopped because of failed payments.
    

* * *

**Discounts and Partnerships**
==============================

Heatmap offers limited discounts and partnership programs to maximize your value.

Annual Plan Discounts
---------------------

For long-term savings, Heatmap offers a 25% discount on annual plans when paid upfront. These discounts can also stack for clients part of our Agency Partner Program, allowing partners to maximize value while providing flexible pricing options for their clients.

Agency Partner Program
----------------------

Heatmap offers an Agency Partner Program designed for agencies managing multiple clients. Agencies can receive a 15% month-to-month discount, which can either be retained or passed along to clients.

For more information on annual plan discounts or how to become a partner, please reach out to [marko@heatmap.com](mailto:marko@heatmap.com)
.

* * *

Refunds
=======

At Heatmap, our goal is to make sure you’re happy with your experience. If something doesn’t go as expected, whether it’s a billing error, a cancellation issue, or you feel you haven’t received the value you were hoping for, our Customer Support team will review your request. Refunds are typically limited to recent charges and, once approved, may take 5–15 business days to appear in your account, depending on your bank or card provider. You’ll receive a confirmation with the refunded amount and the date of the original charge. To get started, please reach out to [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
.

* * *

Have further questions?
=======================

Reach out to our Customer Support team at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
, and we're more than happy to help.

# FAQ: Why Are Certain Pages Excluded from Tracking? | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#main-content)

FAQ: Why Are Certain Pages Excluded from Tracking?
==================================================

May 7, 2026

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_3cdb1b2737)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_3a15121ed4)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_5171662a95)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_f36196c41b)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_388ff16859)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/15013698-faq-why-are-certain-pages-excluded-from-tracking#h_b9a981f535)

Why are some pages on my site not being tracked?
------------------------------------------------

Heatmap.com automatically excludes certain types of pages from tracking by default. This is intentional — not a bug or misconfiguration. The pages excluded fall into two main categories: **password-protected pages** and **highly dynamic pages**.

* * *

Which pages are excluded by default?
------------------------------------

**1\. Account and login pages (e.g., `/account/*`)**

These pages are password-protected. Because Heatmap.com cannot authenticate past a login wall, we're unable to access or track these pages reliably. Additionally, the content within account pages is dynamic — it changes based on the logged-in user — which makes aggregate heatmap data inaccurate and unhelpful.

**2\. Cart pages**

Cart content is dynamic by nature: it changes every time a user adds or removes a product. Tracking a dynamic cart would produce unreliable heatmap data, so cart pages are excluded by default. This is the same logic applied to account pages.

**3\. Tools/recurring subscription pages (e.g., `/tools/recurring/*`)**

Any pages under the `tools/recurring` URL path are excluded. These pages typically display subscription management content that is dynamic and user-specific — similar to cart and account pages. Pages associated with recurring subscription tools are also excluded for the same reason.

* * *

Why does dynamic content cause tracking issues?
-----------------------------------------------

Heatmap data is most accurate when the page layout and content are consistent across sessions. When content changes based on the user (like a cart, an account dashboard, or a subscription management page), heatmap clicks and scroll data can't be meaningfully aggregated — different users are seeing completely different content in the same spot.

* * *

Can these exclusions be changed?
--------------------------------

In most cases, no — these exclusions exist because of fundamental technical limitations (authentication walls, dynamic rendering). If you believe a specific page is being excluded incorrectly, reach out to the support team and we can review it with you.

* * *

What if I need to track behavior near these excluded pages?
-----------------------------------------------------------

Consider tracking the **pages immediately before and after** the excluded section. For example:

*   Track your **product pages** and **collection pages** leading into the cart
    
*   Use **funnel analysis** to see where users drop off before or after excluded steps
    

* * *

Still have questions?
---------------------

If you're unsure whether a specific page on your site is being tracked or excluded, [contact our support team](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
 and we'll take a look at your setup.

# Heatmap Agency Partner Program | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#main-content)

Heatmap Agency Partner Program
==============================

March 23, 2026

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#h_29e06fc1fc)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#h_61308b7e3b)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#h_ca61883349)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#h_5563e25d40)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12525606-heatmap-agency-partner-program#h_5293a66670)

Welcome! We’re thrilled to have you partnering with Heatmap.  
This guide walks you through how to get set up, submit referrals, and earn commission. Feel free to share this with anyone on your team working with Heatmap.

**Applying to the Heatmap Partner Program**
===========================================

  
Becoming a partner is simple:

1.  Visit [https://www.heatmap.com/partners](https://www.heatmap.com/partners)
     and click **“Become a Partner”**
    
2.  Complete the form and **submit** your application
    
3.  Once approved, you’ll receive:
    
    *   A dedicated Slack channel with our team
        
    *   A unique referral link
        
    *   A 15% code (for you to keep as kickback or pass along to clients)
        
    

**How Do Referrals Work?**
==========================

All referrals must be submitted using your **unique partner link**.

When a referred account becomes a paid subscriber:

*   The account is tagged to your partner profile in our CRM
    
*   Commission becomes active once the subscription begins
    

**Important:**

*   Referrals are valid for **30 days** from submission
    
*   If the account does not subscribe within 30 days, the referral expires
    

  
**Commission Structure**
===========================

*   **Duration:** Paid for 12 months
    
*   **Condition:** Commission is paid while the account remains active
    
*   If the account cancels, commission payments stop
    
*   Commission is paid in monthly installments
    
*   Reports are generated quarterly and payouts are processed at the end of each quarter
    

Attribution Policy
==================

Commissions are attributed to the original referred account at the time of signup.  
Additional subscriptions, domains, or expansions are only included if shared upfront as part of the referral.

# Understanding Heatmap vs Shopify Data Differences | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#main-content)

Understanding Heatmap vs Shopify Data Differences
=================================================

Why the Numbers are Different

September 25, 2025

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_b749d186d2)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_2263e0d32c)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_4a77645be1)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_1528483310)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_519cf39ace)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data-differences#h_88d45c2685)

**Introduction**
----------------

Seeing different numbers between Heatmap and Shopify? Good! **That's by design.** Shopify provides a broad view of your store’s overall performance across all channels, while Heatmap is laser-focused on website behavior and engaged sessions. Neither is “right” nor “wrong;” they simply track data differently, which is why their numbers don’t always align.

This article will help you understand how Shopify vs Heatmap approach metrics differently and then get started with Heatmap!

**1\. Shopify “Sessions Over Time” vs Heatmap “Engaged Sessions”**
==================================================================

Shopify defines a session as a continuous period of activity by a visitor, which expires after **30 minutes of inactivity** or at midnight UTC ([Shopify session definition](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/default-reports/acquisition-reports#sessions-over-time-report)
). Even if a visitor lands directly at checkout and buys, Shopify still counts this as a session. ([Shopify acquisition reporting](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/default-reports/acquisition-reports)
).

Heatmap sessions, on the other hand, are engagement-driven: a session only starts when a user clicks, scrolls, or spends at least 5 seconds on the site.  
​

**Comparing Shopify vs Heatmap Session Definitions**
----------------------------------------------------

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Shopify** | **Heatmap** |
| Server-side tracking: counts all hits to your Shopify-hosted store, including passive browsing and bot traffic | Client-side tracking: focused on real browser interactions |
| Sessions include instant bounces, minimal filtering of spam | Filters out accidental visits, bounces, and bots |
| Designed for broad business-level reporting | Specifically built to provide detailed analytics optimized for e-commerce conversion and website improvement.​ |

**Shopify vs Heatmap Key Differences**
--------------------------------------

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559536775/993a58250b2ba853d3af9cb2d4cb/HM+vs+Shopify_2.png?expires=1789486200&signature=3dac5edce0021088b1f37c19e5b194ba1cda9dbb956b6760bb3765975efa0357&req=dSUiH8x9m4ZYXPMW1HO4zdOyuEkOypI6cwBeC5bagB3g5ZJvgCO3L9PbNmrY%0AilvJnOMS%2FYtTrPodFFA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559536775/993a58250b2ba853d3af9cb2d4cb/HM+vs+Shopify_2.png?expires=1789486200&signature=3dac5edce0021088b1f37c19e5b194ba1cda9dbb956b6760bb3765975efa0357&req=dSUiH8x9m4ZYXPMW1HO4zdOyuEkOypI6cwBeC5bagB3g5ZJvgCO3L9PbNmrY%0AilvJnOMS%2FYtTrPodFFA%3D%0A)

**Why This Matters:**
---------------------

Shopify sessions are great for overall traffic volume, while Heatmap sessions show when real shoppers are actually engaging with your site, giving you more accurate data for CRO and UX optimization.

**2\. Shopify vs Heatmap AOV (Average Order Value)**
====================================================

Shopify calculates AOV across all channels (online store, Shop App, social commerce, point-of-sale, etc.). Its formula includes $0 orders, refunds, and exchanges, while excluding shipping and taxes. This often results in a lower reported AOV because these factors pull the average down.

Shopify calculates **Average Order Value (AOV)** using:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559472805/75863f548734e1d3fc7a9eb40292/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+1_49_21%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a19e9307f34f103aac68bd2596be1e8c7185dbeb5745544530513cf08cccc583&req=dSUiH815n4lfXPMW1HO4zXW9IcDJywi0gubmhEkRtqVfBXW3C1co7EtxWfgQ%0AOnuTrrGR0ptL0DT78yo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559472805/75863f548734e1d3fc7a9eb40292/Screenshot+2025-06-06+at+1_49_21%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a19e9307f34f103aac68bd2596be1e8c7185dbeb5745544530513cf08cccc583&req=dSUiH815n4lfXPMW1HO4zXW9IcDJywi0gubmhEkRtqVfBXW3C1co7EtxWfgQ%0AOnuTrrGR0ptL0DT78yo%3D%0A)

Heatmap focuses only on website-originated transactions. It excludes refunds and post-purchase adjustments (like exchanges), while including shipping and taxes in the calculation. Every tracked transaction is tied to an engaged session that began on your site, so the resulting AOV more accurately reflects true customer spending behavior during a visit.

**Heatmap AOV Calculation:**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1719495065/f83f7fa7fe7a3b1798fdcdd6edcc/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B1_50_26-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=44ff1e9d05a3eeaa73e0184b60d9f4622abfe9a8bf2dfada0e4eefd8ee3acc7d&req=dScmH813mIFZXPMW1HO4zWQqxArW6U7D5%2FWOjqD%2FXh5JiHsgPlRBO%2F9Wld0M%0Av4m37qZw0bSHSRlgz4U%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1719495065/f83f7fa7fe7a3b1798fdcdd6edcc/Screenshot%2B2025-06-06%2Bat%2B1_50_26-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=44ff1e9d05a3eeaa73e0184b60d9f4622abfe9a8bf2dfada0e4eefd8ee3acc7d&req=dScmH813mIFZXPMW1HO4zWQqxArW6U7D5%2FWOjqD%2FXh5JiHsgPlRBO%2F9Wld0M%0Av4m37qZw0bSHSRlgz4U%3D%0A)

**Comparing Shopify vs Heatmap AOV Definitions**
------------------------------------------------

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Shopify** | **Heatmap** |
| Includes all channels (online store, Shop App, Social, POS, etc.) | Includes only website transactions |
| Includes $0 orders, refunds, and exchanges | Excludes refunds and exchanges to focus on purchase intent |
| Excludes shipping and taxes | Includes shipping and taxes |

**Why This Matters for Your Business:**
---------------------------------------

Because Shopify’s AOV mixes in $0 orders, returns, and non-website sales, the number can look lower or more volatile than what you see in Heatmap. Heatmap’s AOV strips out these data distortions and focuses purely on the **value of transactions that originate on your website**, giving you a more actionable benchmark for testing pricing strategies, measuring product performance, and guiding conversion rate optimization.

Shopify’s AOV is valuable for **financial reporting across your entire business**, while Heatmap’s AOV is tailored to reveal **how much each engaged website visitor is really worth**.

**3\. Shopify’s "Add to Cart" Metrics**
=======================================

Shopify’s analytics primarily measure **"Sessions with Add-to-Cart"** events, defined as:

*   **Number of sessions** in which **at least one product** was added to a user's cart (Shopify Behavior Reports).
    
*   Shopify **does not explicitly document** counting each individual add-to-cart click within the same session separately, only the presence or absence of at least one cart addition per session.
    

This approach provides broad insights into cart interactions at the session level, which is useful for a general understanding of cart engagement across your site.

Heatmap tracks **individual "Add to Cart" events** explicitly and precisely:

*   Records **every single Add-to-Cart click** independently, offering detailed, granular analytics about actual user interactions.
    
*   Tied explicitly to engaged sessions (real user behavior), allowing marketers to identify precise product interests and optimize accordingly.
    
*   Filters out accidental clicks, bots, and unengaged sessions, ensuring data reflects genuine user intent and actionable insights.
    

**Comparing Shopify vs Heatmap Add to Cart Events**
---------------------------------------------------

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Shopify** | **Heatmap** |
| Counts whether an Add to Cart event fired in a session | Records every Add to Cart event firing independently |
| Session-level metrics (whether or not it's present) | Event-level metrics (precise tracking of each interaction) |
| Useful for general engagement trends | Actionable for product-page optimization and CRO |

**Why This Matters**
--------------------

Shopify’s session-level approach offers a broad sense of cart activity but misses details about the frequency and intensity of engagement within the same session. Heatmap’s detailed, event-level tracking gives you those insights, making it easier to understand exactly how customers interact with products, optimize product pages, and improve conversion rates by focusing on true shopping behavior.

**4\. Shopify Total Sales vs Heatmap Website Revenue**
======================================================

When you click the Analytics tab in Shopify, you’ll see a large chart with a revenue number at the top. This number is **Total Sales**, which is calculated with _all purchase methods_, including off-website sales. While this helps understand overall business performance, it doesn't isolate website-specific transactions.

Shopify’s Total Sales is most useful for business and not website performance for multiple reasons:

*   Subtracts refunds and adjustments
    
*   Includes instant bounces of users who never truly “shopped”
    
*   Includes off-website sources (point-of-sale, TikTok/Instagram shop, Shop App), which are not transactions that originate from your website
    
*   Draft orders are included in this revenue number
    

Heatmap, by contrast, reports Website Revenue only. It includes taxes and shipping in the calculation but may not capture upsell adjustments or subscription renewals that happen after checkout. Heatmap’s goal, as a behavioral analytics tool, is to capture human behavior exclusively on your website.

**Comparing Shopify vs Heatmap Revenue Definitions**
----------------------------------------------------

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Shopify** | **Heatmap** |
| Includes all channels (online store, Shop App, Instagram, TikTok, POS, Draft Orders, etc.) | Includes only website-originated sales |
| Subtracts refunds and adjustments | Excludes refunds |
| Excludes taxes and shipping from AOV | Includes taxes and shipping in AOV |
| Aligns reporting to the store's time zone | Defaults to Eastern Time (GMT-4), which can shift orders placed near midnight |

You may also notice a slight difference in revenue (often less than 5%) when comparing Shopify and Heatmap. A common reason is that some shoppers land directly on Checkout without first browsing the site; Heatmap is designed to exclude these, since they aren’t part of a true shopping session. Additionally, Heatmap records revenue when its tracking snippet fires on the Thank You page. If a user exits too quickly, loses connection, or navigates away before the snippet loads, that order may not be captured. This accounts for 4–8% of conversions being untracked (sometimes 10–12% for mobile or social-heavy traffic). These differences are expected and intentional. Heatmap focuses only on genuine on-site shopping activity, giving you a cleaner lens for website optimization.

**Why This Matters**
--------------------

Discrepancies between Shopify and Heatmap revenue are normal and don’t mean either platform is “wrong.” They reflect differences in **channel coverage, data methodology,** and **tracking scope**. Shopify is built for comprehensive accounting and business reporting, so its totals will almost always be higher. Heatmap is built specifically for website optimization, focusing only on on-site shopper behavior.

Small mismatches can also occur due to untracked conversions, upsell adjustments after checkout, or time zone alignment. For an apples-to-apples comparison, we recommend using Shopify’s **Total Sales by Channel** report and selecting Online Store. That number will align most closely with Heatmap.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1719522229/1209b6d64d72cbf91e32e42de8ee/AD_4nXc6A_Z1rspDCPhJFxhSAvLK2ChlM2IJkrYQ6Ckw1u5C8ERFy47fqHBO-rrHlNYUbEKpBdSrFzG1614VxkwSOVVHnt7-djFXo7Li6-A-s2Kwq4vuwD1klm31C-p0PsrseKVEHPI13Q?expires=1789486200&signature=6e8a79348e6a0168423edddcc7896124339112d9f91375d27a19669e945847f6&req=dScmH8x8n4NdUPMW1HO4zVYu8HaicAreHix3DrFscWx%2FR37BpGxowtY%2FUh85%0AdqLFkOnVsAoV1XiaAWA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1719522229/1209b6d64d72cbf91e32e42de8ee/AD_4nXc6A_Z1rspDCPhJFxhSAvLK2ChlM2IJkrYQ6Ckw1u5C8ERFy47fqHBO-rrHlNYUbEKpBdSrFzG1614VxkwSOVVHnt7-djFXo7Li6-A-s2Kwq4vuwD1klm31C-p0PsrseKVEHPI13Q?expires=1789486200&signature=6e8a79348e6a0168423edddcc7896124339112d9f91375d27a19669e945847f6&req=dScmH8x8n4NdUPMW1HO4zVYu8HaicAreHix3DrFscWx%2FR37BpGxowtY%2FUh85%0AdqLFkOnVsAoV1XiaAWA%3D%0A)

Ultimately, Shopify is your source of truth for accounting, while Heatmap is your best lens for understanding how shoppers behave on your website and where you can optimize conversions.

**5\. Shopify Orders vs Heatmap Purchases**
===========================================

In Shopify, there are two “transactions” metrics: Orders and Orders Fulfilled. Orders as a metric include all sources, including those that are off-website transactions. This will make your Heatmap Purchases metric appear lower than Shopify’s Orders as we are only tracking this metric.

Orders Fulfilled is a better metric to use, as some may be processing, but still reports on all purchase sources beyond your website. You can view Orders Fulfilled on this image below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559459229/63456b8bed8946dbd74b03235ce1/AD_4nXdNZlzPIjBMROAotJ0idhK_ljJY7_gbyA_mSioMMsIKuDLkIwh2Z2f9jHDPSAzy_PDgKcstYOjc9rvjUc64fqq899xu5lNhYNIG8o46UjEQhYh2JqEBUVvSiVtG66U9KUmE_l3YKw?expires=1789486200&signature=52336834abdf1877120640a292bed8173fcc2fd7b5b67fd984a240584fb0a707&req=dSUiH817lINdUPMW1HO4zbV4suinbrXkRHfyPifiRlcxxhQTPd%2FmGsoM9ngr%0AJi6iTCx9pCsNnVrDYFs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1559459229/63456b8bed8946dbd74b03235ce1/AD_4nXdNZlzPIjBMROAotJ0idhK_ljJY7_gbyA_mSioMMsIKuDLkIwh2Z2f9jHDPSAzy_PDgKcstYOjc9rvjUc64fqq899xu5lNhYNIG8o46UjEQhYh2JqEBUVvSiVtG66U9KUmE_l3YKw?expires=1789486200&signature=52336834abdf1877120640a292bed8173fcc2fd7b5b67fd984a240584fb0a707&req=dSUiH817lINdUPMW1HO4zbV4suinbrXkRHfyPifiRlcxxhQTPd%2FmGsoM9ngr%0AJi6iTCx9pCsNnVrDYFs%3D%0A)

Why This Matters
----------------

Heatmap focuses strictly on website behavior, so its purchase counts will be lower than Shopify’s global orders metric. This is intentional as it ensures you see only true website sales activity.

* * *

**Conclusion**
==============

The key takeaway: Shopify and Heatmap are built to answer different questions. Shopify is designed for full-business reporting across channels, while Heatmap is intentionally focused on website engagement, conversions, and actionable insights.

By using Heatmap’s session-based lens, you get a clearer picture of how often shoppers return, engage, and convert on your site, helping you optimize UX, CRO, and revenue growth.

How to make your FAQ's powerful
===============================

FAQ optimization is crucial because users often turn to FAQs when they can't find the desired content on a webpage.

*   Analyzing FAQs is valuable not only for optimizing the content but also for understanding what users want to see.
    
*   It's recommended to have more than six to eight questions in your FAQ section, depending on the nature of the product or service.
    
*   To optimize FAQs, check the "revenue per click" and "revenue per session" for each question and rearrange them based on the highest to lowest "revenue per session."
    
*   Underperforming questions can be removed to improve the FAQ section's effectiveness.
    
*   Add a conversational tone to your FAQ - if customers are reading this, they are more serious about a possible purchase than others, so you can showcase your brand's personality/voice here to drive purchase velocity.
    
*   Consider running customer feedback surveys to understand users' questions and concerns better.
    
*   Placing FAQs higher on the page can improve conversion rates, revenue per session, and average order value.
    
*   FAQs should provide answers to users' questions that may not be covered in the main content.
    

Here's a great example from Every Dose of being concise, answering customer questions, and having fun with the process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/835159095/562e89eb46327bdd9c034848/CleanShot+2023-09-20+at+10.11.23%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a506e341395765ae1d9a7dcb1cafb4cdddfd2bdc5e6177c094420eb6f9cd4301&req=fCMiF8x3nYhaFb4f3HP0gEDIQob1YrrC5OKn%2F1hIqFxQVrU7IoRolJ%2FFM9Iz%0AJ5ZcRYy77uYESe7Xkg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/835159095/562e89eb46327bdd9c034848/CleanShot+2023-09-20+at+10.11.23%402x.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a506e341395765ae1d9a7dcb1cafb4cdddfd2bdc5e6177c094420eb6f9cd4301&req=fCMiF8x3nYhaFb4f3HP0gEDIQob1YrrC5OKn%2F1hIqFxQVrU7IoRolJ%2FFM9Iz%0AJ5ZcRYy77uYESe7Xkg%3D%3D%0A)

Now it's time for you to make your FAQ the highest performing, brand-centered section it can be. Excited to see your 🔥 results.

Policies
========

December 18, 2025

This article outlines Heatmap policies for free trials, refunds, cancellations, and account restarts.

Free Trial Policy
=================

All new accounts are eligible to receive a 14-day free trial of the Behavioral Suite when signing up for full access to the platform. Users are auto-billed at the end of the free trial period.

If you run into any issues getting started like setup questions, tracking concerns, or account access, our team is happy to help. Please contact [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
, and we’ll make sure you’re taken care of.

* * *

Refund Policy
=============

We want you to have a great experience with Heatmap. If something isn’t working as expected, we’ll work with you to make it right.

Refunds and/or credits are considered on a case-by-case basis. When evaluating a request, we may consider things like:

*   the nature of the issue and its impact on your experience
    
*   account usage and timeframe
    
*   what troubleshooting steps have already been attempted
    

To request a refund or credit, email our support team at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
 with your account details and a brief summary of what happened. Our support team will review your request and follow up with next steps.

* * *

Cancellation Policy
===================

If you decide to cancel, we appreciate the time you've spent with Heatmap. You can cancel at any time, and you'll retain access through the end of your current billing period.

If you'd like to reconsider Heatmap in the future, we're happy to help you get started again. In many cases, customers returning 6+ months after cancellation may be eligible for another free trial. If you restart your subscription in the future, it will be billed at the current price.

If you have questions about canceling, billing, or restarting your account, please reach out to [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
.
