Magento Installation Guide
==========================

How to Install Heatmap Snippet on Your Magento Store

April 21, 2026

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11832624-magento-installation-guide#h_1f45f6ee33)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11832624-magento-installation-guide#h_d67520b0ca)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11832624-magento-installation-guide#h_34d99868e4)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11832624-magento-installation-guide#h_2077904f9d)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11832624-magento-installation-guide#h_160637fb99)

To fully enable heatmap functionality on your Magneto store, you'll need to install two important snippets: the **Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet** and the **Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet**. Installing both snippets will allow Heatmap to properly track all customer interactions and revenue data.

**Accessing your Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet:**
=================================================

In order to access your **code snippets,** you can follow these steps:

1.  Go to the Settings tab within your portal.
    
2.  Click "Snippet"
    
3.  Here you will see the **Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet** to copy into your Magento site
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665161603/a1d406cb3b23ec304112acb3eba3/Screenshot+2025-08-11+at+11_31_36%E2%80%AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=84fc2683958ca3814a615e1363c1b4d303ac0bb053b31b9a130d7d709aab5856&req=dSYhE8h4nIdfWvMW1HO4zTwan1dHsrjfSvG%2F62UahAyPLxBfYS0eQiML4fGn%0AgZ6LkEvz59itsTMlz8o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665161603/a1d406cb3b23ec304112acb3eba3/Screenshot+2025-08-11+at+11_31_36%E2%80%AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=84fc2683958ca3814a615e1363c1b4d303ac0bb053b31b9a130d7d709aab5856&req=dSYhE8h4nIdfWvMW1HO4zTwan1dHsrjfSvG%2F62UahAyPLxBfYS0eQiML4fGn%0AgZ6LkEvz59itsTMlz8o%3D%0A)

* * *

Installing your Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet
=============================================

For a visual guide on installing the code snippet, watch this video below:

**Installing the Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet**
------------------------------------------------

The Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet is what tracks the user interactions on your website.

Follow these step-by-step instructions to ensure proper installation:

1.  Log in to your Magento Admin Dashboard
    
2.  Go to the **Content** tab on the side panel
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179125/bfea19966c9b9a37af473e97f6d7/AD_4nXe2BRsPyN5JeBGOWOsR9VuUl9J5k1NqItuxFPdYtPi_zxLBUiFWXXshJ6zhv0AiM2O4P_a7itNbAqBlxtTrtPvbAhaP-PXtI5Hr02sBn7FQp4fjTWEQYBYIIcxizwFqXpatQ-2ZQg?expires=1789486200&signature=f9f2f71057e50a58e6c6c8d05d907100c192f35ad7d075bbe9af15cd7d1c10a6&req=dSYhE8h5lIBdXPMW1HO4zcuUgiefsbbnM56c8zDYDCUaIHghnKgBHg3adfBN%0AKzsQ%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179125/bfea19966c9b9a37af473e97f6d7/AD_4nXe2BRsPyN5JeBGOWOsR9VuUl9J5k1NqItuxFPdYtPi_zxLBUiFWXXshJ6zhv0AiM2O4P_a7itNbAqBlxtTrtPvbAhaP-PXtI5Hr02sBn7FQp4fjTWEQYBYIIcxizwFqXpatQ-2ZQg?expires=1789486200&signature=f9f2f71057e50a58e6c6c8d05d907100c192f35ad7d075bbe9af15cd7d1c10a6&req=dSYhE8h5lIBdXPMW1HO4zcuUgiefsbbnM56c8zDYDCUaIHghnKgBHg3adfBN%0AKzsQ%0A)
    
3.  Under **Design**, select **Configuration**, where you'll see a list of your available store views and themes.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179384/0d851c13d3ed74800819de90b910/AD_4nXf9nDJ6-4RqGzfyz-KnRzWt0ScH9Ot1OavRH22_igL3xCMO86khFjWIMGfVxBJL8OrB1iYYBB0oPVCAS5XxWJiYJA-b_9HB48xrdTS2THTI4Jv2mQ31r1pJgrE30DCXWsm8nnckdQ?expires=1789486200&signature=272cb8aa4adf0b45f7eece5cf8fe29af1ba23558b288c39a3d0b720843c13a34&req=dSYhE8h5lIJXXfMW1HO4zZqxfJ3DzLWG0aztUVahdTkNrgX%2FbCTct6uN9w3S%0AwZTj%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179384/0d851c13d3ed74800819de90b910/AD_4nXf9nDJ6-4RqGzfyz-KnRzWt0ScH9Ot1OavRH22_igL3xCMO86khFjWIMGfVxBJL8OrB1iYYBB0oPVCAS5XxWJiYJA-b_9HB48xrdTS2THTI4Jv2mQ31r1pJgrE30DCXWsm8nnckdQ?expires=1789486200&signature=272cb8aa4adf0b45f7eece5cf8fe29af1ba23558b288c39a3d0b720843c13a34&req=dSYhE8h5lIJXXfMW1HO4zZqxfJ3DzLWG0aztUVahdTkNrgX%2FbCTct6uN9w3S%0AwZTj%0A)
    
4.  Find the right store view or theme you want to add the snippet to and click "**Edit**"
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179676/2ad9002c2b6c1ce86cf643eeb42c/AD_4nXcl6IJI5lgiQ0l7jAPhhuCcZbdCrWOeR_4H5OWRiQrBSoKbIiOeDXnESWmwNZy4qtse1fkUN8JJsSr9LfpcGdTf2-0DjXXb3jbZo-n6_hjT3x5xL8k21ybxcQdzZVnAgZ8ayOfxEQ?expires=1789486200&signature=b0661281e4e4525b44ad5673be058ec1c93b69de8081c6d7d7c9ba39cec4ab2b&req=dSYhE8h5lIdYX%2FMW1HO4zbSmbsKOY1zSoBOH7t9ooeeEHmNfL%2BbxjHQMwnkm%0A%2F37W%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665179676/2ad9002c2b6c1ce86cf643eeb42c/AD_4nXcl6IJI5lgiQ0l7jAPhhuCcZbdCrWOeR_4H5OWRiQrBSoKbIiOeDXnESWmwNZy4qtse1fkUN8JJsSr9LfpcGdTf2-0DjXXb3jbZo-n6_hjT3x5xL8k21ybxcQdzZVnAgZ8ayOfxEQ?expires=1789486200&signature=b0661281e4e4525b44ad5673be058ec1c93b69de8081c6d7d7c9ba39cec4ab2b&req=dSYhE8h5lIdYX%2FMW1HO4zbSmbsKOY1zSoBOH7t9ooeeEHmNfL%2BbxjHQMwnkm%0A%2F37W%0A)
    
5.  Scroll down the Edit Theme page and find the **Other Settings** section. Then click on the **HTML Head** dropdown.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665180181/27bac934da63f99e12e6e66c7938/AD_4nXfb0FH5JlHSgM4D0i7vLWvPY9K5XCMjbAnnFuJ4qWCvvu0RN4bYRK75OaWKc8dq5hWrR4jcFtVqwAAdTFO6X4IdXmFbdQ_ZsjiTAFZIEsAdbNSjACNjGDCbvRXqng8Z4RJgtGtr?expires=1789486200&signature=b2684f8cb5a9913b826457a3c2b64a5b12015852d0f61c803c62a2d94f416ce5&req=dSYhE8h2nYBXWPMW1HO4zfAXHAYOxK9gkTZSAjPsjEgAmxyWnvjdHOTkXN8f%0AoRm3%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665180181/27bac934da63f99e12e6e66c7938/AD_4nXfb0FH5JlHSgM4D0i7vLWvPY9K5XCMjbAnnFuJ4qWCvvu0RN4bYRK75OaWKc8dq5hWrR4jcFtVqwAAdTFO6X4IdXmFbdQ_ZsjiTAFZIEsAdbNSjACNjGDCbvRXqng8Z4RJgtGtr?expires=1789486200&signature=b2684f8cb5a9913b826457a3c2b64a5b12015852d0f61c803c62a2d94f416ce5&req=dSYhE8h2nYBXWPMW1HO4zfAXHAYOxK9gkTZSAjPsjEgAmxyWnvjdHOTkXN8f%0AoRm3%0A)
    
6.  Copy & paste the Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet under the "Scripts and Style Sheets" text field as the last entry in this box. _Note:_ _Make sure to not delete or overwrite any existing scripts in this field._
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665180701/838dc0116a4f6fe5a49c8ac520df/AD_4nXdeS415C6oCJXYAmCsM0WDAThwfEo4AJdwz1Pi7n_YoN9iCnmjXkButH-Of2b7g9Mu7RwDGPZFSv3Xyj-Md6a0HlIxFAtkChWyldU_gCo1-RM-tdPmzQlTmm5jj2fEFpoxu3tSJmA?expires=1789486200&signature=1689b06c2fc7e7b2a5c32d55a659cf2447927e28e28b03a0663b0004d8ab1380&req=dSYhE8h2nYZfWPMW1HO4zccsMlfX5%2FH8nSHGP%2FAA6fNj%2Fc7PAbxeZQermgB%2B%0A%2FusO%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1665180701/838dc0116a4f6fe5a49c8ac520df/AD_4nXdeS415C6oCJXYAmCsM0WDAThwfEo4AJdwz1Pi7n_YoN9iCnmjXkButH-Of2b7g9Mu7RwDGPZFSv3Xyj-Md6a0HlIxFAtkChWyldU_gCo1-RM-tdPmzQlTmm5jj2fEFpoxu3tSJmA?expires=1789486200&signature=1689b06c2fc7e7b2a5c32d55a659cf2447927e28e28b03a0663b0004d8ab1380&req=dSYhE8h2nYZfWPMW1HO4zccsMlfX5%2FH8nSHGP%2FAA6fNj%2Fc7PAbxeZQermgB%2B%0A%2FusO%0A)
    
7.  Click Save Configuration.
    
8.  To ensure your changes go live immediately, you need to flush the Magento cache.
    
    1.  Go to **System > Cache Management**.
        
    2.  Then click **Flush Magento Cache** to flush.
        
    

**Additional Tips:**

*   If you have multiple store views or themes, repeat these steps for each one where you want Heatmap tracking.
    

* * *

**Snippet Installation Verification**
-------------------------------------

After installation and official verification on the heatmap platform, wait about 12 hours for data to start appearing in your heatmap dashboard. To verify your snippet:

2.  Click "Snippet"
    
3.  Click the "Verify My Snippet" button in the bottom right corner.

# Do Not Track with Cookies | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10022260-do-not-track-with-cookies#main-content)

Do Not Track with Cookies
=========================

Do Not Track, privacy, cookies, DNT compliance, session analytics, anonymous data, cross-site tracking, privacy policy, support

October 21, 2024

**Do Not Track with Cookies**

Heatmap.com respects user privacy and complies with "Do Not Track" (DNT) requests. Here's what you need to know about our approach to tracking and cookies:

**What is "Do Not Track"?**

"Do Not Track" is a web browser setting that requests websites not to track your online activities.

**How Heatmap.com Handles DNT Requests**

1\. \*\*No Cookie Tracking:\*\* When a DNT signal is detected, Heatmap.com does not set any cookies on the user's browser.

2\. \*\*Session-Based Analytics:\*\* We still collect anonymous, aggregated data for website analytics, but this information is not tied to any individual user or stored long-term.

3\. \*\*No Cross-Site Tracking:\*\* We do not track users across different websites or share data with third-party advertising networks.

**What This Means for Website Owners**

\- You can use Heatmap.com while respecting your visitors' privacy choices.

\- Some advanced features that rely on user-specific data may have limited functionality for users with DNT enabled.

\- Overall site analytics will still provide valuable insights without compromising individual privacy.

**How to Verify DNT Compliance**

To check if Heatmap.com is respecting DNT signals on your site:

1\. Enable DNT in your browser settings.

2\. Visit your website with Heatmap.com installed.

3\. Check your browser's cookie storage - you should not see any Heatmap.com cookies.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our \[Privacy Policy\](link-to-privacy-policy).

If you have any questions about DNT or our data collection practices, please contact our support team at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
.

# Understanding AI Naming in Heatmap.com | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10022272-understanding-ai-naming-in-heatmap-com#main-content)

Understanding AI Naming in Heatmap.com
======================================

AI naming, Heatmap.com, machine learning, automatic labeling, website elements, buttons, forms, navigation, HTML naming conventions, element editor, support

October 21, 2024

**Understanding AI Naming in Heatmap.com**

AI naming is a powerful feature in Heatmap.com that automatically identifies and labels key elements on your website. This article explains how it works and how to use it effectively.

**What is AI Naming?**

AI naming uses machine learning algorithms to analyze your website's structure and content, automatically assigning descriptive names to important elements like buttons, forms, and navigation items.

**Availability**

AI naming is available by default on all heatmaps in Heatmap.com. There's no need to enable this feature separately - it works automatically to enhance your heatmap analysis.

**Benefits of AI Naming**

\- Saves time by eliminating manual labeling

\- Ensures consistent naming across your site

\- Improves accuracy of heatmap and user behavior analysis

**Best Practices for Accurate AI Naming**

To ensure the most accurate AI naming results:

1\. Use standard best practices when building your website.

2\. Implement proper naming conventions for your HTML elements.

3\. Use appropriate HTML tags and elements for their intended purposes.

4\. Provide descriptive IDs and classes for important elements.

Following these practices will significantly improve the AI's ability to correctly identify and name elements on your site.

**Customizing AI-Generated Names**

While AI naming is generally accurate, you can always adjust names if needed:

1\. Open your heatmap view.

2\. Click on any element to see its AI-generated name.

3\. Use the element editor to customize the name if desired.

If you encounter any issues with AI naming or need further assistance, please contact our support team at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
.

# Troubleshooting: Dots Visible but No Revenue Data | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10022307-troubleshooting-dots-visible-but-no-revenue-data#main-content)

Troubleshooting: Dots Visible but No Revenue Data
=================================================

pixel, revenue tracking, Shopify, pixel installation, troubleshooting, tracking snippet, checkout page, browser console, cache, site ID

October 21, 2024

**Troubleshooting: Dots Visible but No Revenue Data - Heatmap Pixel Not Active**

If you're seeing interaction dots on your heatmap but not recording any revenue data, it's likely that your main Heatmap.com tracking snippet is working, but the Heatmap Pixel for revenue tracking is not active. This guide will help you troubleshoot and resolve this issue.

**Understanding the Problem**

Heatmap.com uses two components for complete tracking:

1\. The main tracking snippet (for general user interactions)

2\. The Heatmap Pixel (for capturing revenue data)

When you see dots but no revenue, it indicates that only the main snippet is functioning correctly.

**Common Causes**

1\. Heatmap Pixel not installed

2\. Heatmap Pixel installed incorrectly

3\. Conflicts with other scripts on the checkout page

4\. Caching issues on the checkout page

**Troubleshooting Steps**

1\. Verify Heatmap Pixel Installation

\- Log into your Shopify admin panel.

\- Go to Settings > Customer Events.

\- Check if the Heatmap Pixel is listed under custom pixels.

**2\. Review Pixel Setup**

\- If the Heatmap Pixel is not listed, you need to add it.

\- Click on "Add custom pixel" and name it "heatmap-revenue".

\- Paste the provided Heatmap Pixel code into the text area.

3\. Check for Typos or Modifications

\- Compare the installed Heatmap Pixel code with the original provided by Heatmap.com.

\- Look for any accidental modifications, missing characters, or typos.

**4\. Activate the Pixel**

\- After adding the pixel, ensure you click on "Connect" to activate it.

**5\. Clear Cache and Test**

\- Clear your Shopify theme cache.

\- Make a test purchase to verify if revenue data is being captured.

**6\. Inspect Browser Console on Checkout Page**

\- Complete a test purchase on your site.

\- On the order confirmation page, open your browser's developer tools (F12 or right-click > Inspect).

\- Check the console for any error messages related to Heatmap.com or the pixel.

**7\. Verify Correct Site ID**

\- Ensure the Site ID in your Heatmap Pixel matches the one in your Heatmap.com account and main tracking snippet.

**Still Not Working?**

If you've tried these steps and still don't see revenue data:

1\. Confirm that you've made test purchases after correctly installing the pixel.

2\. Check that you're viewing the correct date range in your Heatmap.com dashboard.

3\. Ensure your account has the appropriate plan level for revenue tracking.

**Contacting Support**

If the issue persists, please contact our support team at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
 with the following information:

\- Your Shopify store URL

\- Screenshots of your Customer Events page showing the Heatmap Pixel

\- Any error messages from the browser console on the checkout page

\- Steps you've already taken to troubleshoot

Our team will be glad to assist you in getting your revenue tracking fully operational.

Remember, accurate revenue data is crucial for optimizing your conversion funnel and maximizing ROI. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need any assistance!

Last Updated: 10/21/2024

# Custom Website Installation Guide | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508519-custom-website-installation-guide#main-content)

Custom Website Installation Guide
=================================

How to Install Heatmap Snippets on a Custom-Built Website

Updated this week

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508519-custom-website-installation-guide#h_5b3ea54580)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508519-custom-website-installation-guide#h_ff58f7d58e)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508519-custom-website-installation-guide#h_f47d10333b)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508519-custom-website-installation-guide#h_dae1d0f2e7)

This guide will walk you through the process of installing Heatmap on your custom-built website. There are two snippets you will need to install in order to configure tracking correctly: the **Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet** and the **Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet**.

**Accessing your Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet & Heatmap Conversion Code Snippets**
===================================================================================

In order to access your **code snippets,** you can follow these steps:

1.  Log in to your Heatmap.com account and go to the Settings tab within your portal.
    
2.  Click "Snippet"
    
3.  Here you will see two codes available to copy
    
    *   The **Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet** will be placed in the Header tag of your website to trea
        
    *   The **Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet** will be the conversion snippet at the order confirmation page.
        
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634954217/51938b71377a8476724a1b420b1e/image+%281%29.png?expires=1789486200&signature=b718e6758b902fc5851f00060dcfdbec65c167c89a87d515926a99ebb2776db4&req=dSYkEsB7mYNeXvMW1HO4zc%2FNMGx%2Ban1iAGJIcdFWsgE7aylcZrh7gu5Hficr%0AxBLecVEoCHK6DnNaEV8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634954217/51938b71377a8476724a1b420b1e/image+%281%29.png?expires=1789486200&signature=b718e6758b902fc5851f00060dcfdbec65c167c89a87d515926a99ebb2776db4&req=dSYkEsB7mYNeXvMW1HO4zc%2FNMGx%2Ban1iAGJIcdFWsgE7aylcZrh7gu5Hficr%0AxBLecVEoCHK6DnNaEV8%3D%0A)

* * *

**Installing Both the Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet & Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet**
=======================================================================================

The Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet is what tracks the user interactions on your website. To ensure successful installation of your heatmap tracking code snippet, please follow these steps:

1.  Open your website's HTML file or content management system.
    
2.  Locate the \`<head>\` section of your website's template or main HTML file.
    
3.  Copy & paste the Heatmap Tracking Code Snippet just before the closing \`</head>\` tag.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634956193/70e36bef2862810e2add46b53f91/image+%281%29+copy.png?expires=1789486200&signature=8f26c09eacabee8a270be082b9b494fc5f281437e19a885ea584d16d4b987f77&req=dSYkEsB7m4BWWvMW1HO4zdATi2RIve%2FUN%2BlKUj5iMnn34WXzOvgSPnwQSgvF%0A%2BKgBURVEOo%2F7bI95TDQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634956193/70e36bef2862810e2add46b53f91/image+%281%29+copy.png?expires=1789486200&signature=8f26c09eacabee8a270be082b9b494fc5f281437e19a885ea584d16d4b987f77&req=dSYkEsB7m4BWWvMW1HO4zdATi2RIve%2FUN%2BlKUj5iMnn34WXzOvgSPnwQSgvF%0A%2BKgBURVEOo%2F7bI95TDQ%3D%0A)

⚠️ **Important!** Please note heatmap's snippet must be the first snippet at the top of your header for maximum data accuracy.

If you have other snippets above, this may reduce accuracy of data collection.

4\. Copy & paste the second snippet, the **Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet** at the purchase confirmation stage within your custom website.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634956966/ee3decd1535a33aef8d676df0504/image+%281%29+copy+2.png?expires=1789486200&signature=2928daee4984863a3ca17d2a2ea12a60bc15d0dc12e39635001e515a41e0355e&req=dSYkEsB7m4hZX%2FMW1HO4zVdyyGb2Vt720KcBYWfufsUSh2nwbC%2FZ%2FIMFULCj%0As8pzIJdLGe6zXqJazAo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634956966/ee3decd1535a33aef8d676df0504/image+%281%29+copy+2.png?expires=1789486200&signature=2928daee4984863a3ca17d2a2ea12a60bc15d0dc12e39635001e515a41e0355e&req=dSYkEsB7m4hZX%2FMW1HO4zVdyyGb2Vt720KcBYWfufsUSh2nwbC%2FZ%2FIMFULCj%0As8pzIJdLGe6zXqJazAo%3D%0A)

*   You can also install the **Heatmap Conversion Code Snippet** using Google Tag Manager – [see this article here](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508574-how-to-install-with-google-tag-manager)
    .
    

⚠️ **Note!** Ensure that you do not install either snippet twice, which would create double tracking.

* * *

**Snippet Installation Verification**
-------------------------------------

After installation and official verification on the heatmap platform, wait about 12 hours for data to start appearing in your heatmap dashboard. To verify your snippet:

1.  Log in to your Heatmap.com account and go to the Settings tab within your portal.
    
2.  Click "Snippet"
    
3.  Click the "Verify My Snippet" button in the bottom right corner.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634957550/77a7bd5b2e42633f0c5ac69aa9b3/image+%281%29+copy+3.png?expires=1789486200&signature=d352cc776fe46b17c2af1094083a438c1e43f99d9651a24e64722b85c1098fad&req=dSYkEsB7moRaWfMW1HO4zRJrsAmOpuGuN2tZproyImrpdo74ULt0RkpiVN9R%0AV8oU%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1634957550/77a7bd5b2e42633f0c5ac69aa9b3/image+%281%29+copy+3.png?expires=1789486200&signature=d352cc776fe46b17c2af1094083a438c1e43f99d9651a24e64722b85c1098fad&req=dSYkEsB7moRaWfMW1HO4zRJrsAmOpuGuN2tZproyImrpdo74ULt0RkpiVN9R%0AV8oU%0A)
    
4.  You'll receive a pop-up validating if the snippet was installed correctly. If you don't see any data after 24 hours or believe there is a data collection issue, double-check that both snippets are correctly installed.
    

* * *

**Need Help?**
--------------

If you have questions or run into any issues while using Heatmap, our support team is here to help. Contact us anytime at [Support@heatmap.com](mailto:Support@heatmap.com)
.

# Why can't I view my site in Heatmap Interactive Mode? | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#main-content)

Why can't I view my site in Heatmap Interactive Mode?
=====================================================

How to Unblock Heatmap from Your Site's Security Settings

October 13, 2025

Table of contents

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_b1f991df90)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_70dcd791b8)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_fe209c2f7b)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_6d5f14f5ad)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_66a4e353d2)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_cc6b207ed5)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_6e05ef49fb)

[](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12143003-why-can-t-i-view-my-site-in-heatmap-interactive-mode#h_0d74edd6ca)

When you try to view your website in our Heatmap’s Interactive Mode, you may sometimes see an error message or a blank screen. This usually happens because your site’s security settings such as Cloudflare or other protective configurations are blocking our tool from loading. While this means your security is working as intended, it also prevents the heatmap from rendering correctly. To fix the issue and ensure you can view your site in Interactive Mode, you’ll need to add our heatmap domains to your security whitelist.

* * *

**Instructions on How to Whitelist Our Domains**
================================================

Whitelisting our domains in your security provider's settings will allow your site content to load without being blocked.

**Domains to Whitelist**
------------------------

Add **all** of the following domains to your whitelist:

*   heatmap.com
    
*   heatmapcore.com
    
*   \*.heatmap.com (wildcard for all subdomains)
    
*   \*.heatmapcore.com (wildcard for all subdomains)
    

**Important:** **You must add all four entries for the heatmap to work properly.** The wildcard entries (with \*) ensure that all our service subdomains can connect.

Step-by-Step Instructions on How to Whitelist our Domains
---------------------------------------------------------

1.  **Identify Your Security Provider**
    
    *   Check if you're using Cloudflare, Sucuri, Wordfence, or another security service
        
    *   If unsure, contact your web administrator or hosting provider
        
    
2.  **Access Your Security Settings**
    
    *   Log into your security provider's dashboard
        
    *   Navigate to the firewall or security rules section
        
    
3.  **Add Our Domains to Your Whitelist**
    
    *   Look for options like "IP Whitelist," "Allow List," or "Firewall Rules"
        
    *   Add each domain listed above separately
        
    *   Save your changes
        
    
4.  **Test the Connection**
    
    *   Wait 2-5 minutes for changes to take effect
        
    *   Return to the heatmap tool and try interactive mode again
        
    *   Your site should now load properly
        
    

**Platform-Specific Instructions**
----------------------------------

### **For Cloudflare Users:**

1.  Go to **Security** → **WAF** → **Tools**
    
2.  Select **IP Access Rules** or **Page Rules**
    
3.  Add each domain with "Allow" action:
    
    *   heatmap.com
        
    *   heatmapcore.com
        
    *   \*.heatmap.com
        
    *   \*.heatmapcore.com
        
    
4.  Apply to all websites or specific zones
    
5.  Save and deploy changes
    

### **For Other Security Providers:**

*   Look for "Whitelist," "Allow List," or "Trusted Sources"
    
*   Some providers may require adding domains to a "CORS" or "Referrer" whitelist
    
*   The process is similar across most providers
    

* * *

**Frequently Asked Questions**
------------------------------

**Q: Do I need to add all four domains?**

**A:** Yes. All four domains are required for full functionality. The main domains handle core services, while the wildcard entries ensure all features work properly.

**Q: Is it safe to whitelist these domains?**

**A:** Yes. Our heatmap tool only reads publicly available content to generate visual analytics. We don't modify your site or access sensitive data.

**Q: How long does whitelisting take to work?**

**A:** Most changes take effect within 5 minutes, though some providers may take up to 30 minutes.

**Q: What if my security system doesn't support wildcards?**

**A:** Contact our support team. We can provide a list of specific subdomains to whitelist instead.

**Q: What if I don't have access to security settings?**

**A:** Contact your IT team or web administrator. Share this article with them to explain what needs to be done.

* * *

**Still Having Issues?**
========================

Troubleshooting Checklist:
--------------------------

If you've whitelisted all domains but still can't view your site in interactive mode:

*   Double-check that you've added all four domains exactly as shown
    
*   Ensure wildcards (\*) are properly formatted
    
*   Clear your browser cache and cookies
    
*   Try using a different browser
    
*   Check if you have multiple security layers that might need updating
    

* * *

**Need Help?**
==============

Our support team is available Monday-Friday, 9 AM-5 PM EST. When contacting us, please include:

*   Your website URL
    
*   Your security provider (Cloudflare, etc.)
    
*   Which domains you have already whitelisted
    
*   Any error messages you're seeing

**Free Version Guide**
======================

**Getting Started**
-------------------

1.  Launch the **Heatmap Chrome Extension**.
    
2.  You’ll see a primary option: **Begin Scan**.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977901/715e40331603edd45d17cee05a41/f5ffdea7-a9e3-4585-a136-46083b0e96cc?expires=1789486200&signature=349cdd816ee876fef90ff05196305bbc09a7447b52dc631c8816688dbe5c6f00&req=diUjEcB5mohfWPMW1HO4zRSE1XyHadODBBQkjb7IiKBpkv4qbV4j4N6WcAjE%0AuFPx9iSQkKbqO2fHTcI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977901/715e40331603edd45d17cee05a41/f5ffdea7-a9e3-4585-a136-46083b0e96cc?expires=1789486200&signature=349cdd816ee876fef90ff05196305bbc09a7447b52dc631c8816688dbe5c6f00&req=diUjEcB5mohfWPMW1HO4zRSE1XyHadODBBQkjb7IiKBpkv4qbV4j4N6WcAjE%0AuFPx9iSQkKbqO2fHTcI%3D%0A)

_The extension's landing screen — Wilson prompts you to begin your first scan._

**Running a Page Scan**
-----------------------

1.  Click **Begin Scan**.
    
2.  **Wilson, your AI CRO Expert**, scans your webpage and analyses each section until the scan reaches **100% completion**.
    
3.  Once the scan is complete, your results are automatically saved in a **Scan File**.
    
4.  Click to review and analyse your page insights.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977893/efcfbb93b918941c40d0a1033102/1b764189-2080-49ea-b934-a03a61289bbe?expires=1789486200&signature=9fdfc2ae4c15c68d25664f129dcd2cc09ad96b6f41bb8d1521f11f6a8f087a7d&req=diUjEcB5molWWvMW1HO4zam%2FD%2BuQZtCKhL1pTYtiWNaHjfUC8CZNbqxVaZQ1%0AKjCTLkjvRbYn%2FOgBrMM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977893/efcfbb93b918941c40d0a1033102/1b764189-2080-49ea-b934-a03a61289bbe?expires=1789486200&signature=9fdfc2ae4c15c68d25664f129dcd2cc09ad96b6f41bb8d1521f11f6a8f087a7d&req=diUjEcB5molWWvMW1HO4zam%2FD%2BuQZtCKhL1pTYtiWNaHjfUC8CZNbqxVaZQ1%0AKjCTLkjvRbYn%2FOgBrMM%3D%0A)

_Wilson analyses the page in real time across UX, code, and speed._

**Understanding Your Results**
------------------------------

After opening the scan results, you can:

*   Review the AI-generated analysis of your webpage.
    
*   Click **Pin Chat** to receive more detailed insights and recommendations.
    
*   Click **Re-run Scan** at any time to perform a fresh analysis.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977894/7e8fb9e6a58fe0b0263fce650d88/fda5fcef-c7ec-4f56-b293-691e0572b903?expires=1789486200&signature=87440d12f0372078169a4e2f3022c57be719bf8cef8cc106a66f1c5828ff3987&req=diUjEcB5molWXfMW1HO4zWnCf12r3b35WfHrMz%2FpLqJe8jQ4IeW%2FhVbX2bqs%0A33dEzY%2BJcGDict0UQzU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977894/7e8fb9e6a58fe0b0263fce650d88/fda5fcef-c7ec-4f56-b293-691e0572b903?expires=1789486200&signature=87440d12f0372078169a4e2f3022c57be719bf8cef8cc106a66f1c5828ff3987&req=diUjEcB5molWXfMW1HO4zWnCf12r3b35WfHrMz%2FpLqJe8jQ4IeW%2FhVbX2bqs%0A33dEzY%2BJcGDict0UQzU%3D%0A)

_Scan results surface prioritized, actionable to-dos._

**Explore Heatmap & Journey Analysis (Demo)**
---------------------------------------------

Explore the Heatmap and Journey Analysis tabs through an interactive demo to see how these features work.

**To do this:**

*   Access the menu icon
    
*   Select the Heatmap tab or Journey Analysis tab
    
*   Click the Start Tracking button
    
*   Interact with elements on your current webpage
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977896/25f1aef3ba10ce6322230f046419/a0b05c8d-7eb1-44ce-af54-367f19163e58?expires=1789486200&signature=a15795e504120e1d637cdeab560712351b89ae95176d7df6b93bd2457fdd66c1&req=diUjEcB5molWX%2FMW1HO4zSk9G58cgkd94tMAzcAcy5TpY5dASUvOJjIFZpcO%0A5dDSX4Cp58n3nivSzYA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977896/25f1aef3ba10ce6322230f046419/a0b05c8d-7eb1-44ce-af54-367f19163e58?expires=1789486200&signature=a15795e504120e1d637cdeab560712351b89ae95176d7df6b93bd2457fdd66c1&req=diUjEcB5molWX%2FMW1HO4zSk9G58cgkd94tMAzcAcy5TpY5dASUvOJjIFZpcO%0A5dDSX4Cp58n3nivSzYA%3D%0A)

_Live click-tracking demo._

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977909/7a10200ee086c37b996fea4e14a9/1210df37-18e5-49f1-9632-e45f80d2bef3?expires=1789486200&signature=06eeb9e5e4ee820e4b59271c02dba8e42d9ba794349a1b561f1da41c4f10b664&req=diUjEcB5mohfUPMW1HO4zQfxen9BmOfJHsaS7L3OwZx6Gqo%2BwPzXpp1P0l1s%0AT7q72ZCbBZw4uwWO9pQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977909/7a10200ee086c37b996fea4e14a9/1210df37-18e5-49f1-9632-e45f80d2bef3?expires=1789486200&signature=06eeb9e5e4ee820e4b59271c02dba8e42d9ba794349a1b561f1da41c4f10b664&req=diUjEcB5mohfUPMW1HO4zQfxen9BmOfJHsaS7L3OwZx6Gqo%2BwPzXpp1P0l1s%0AT7q72ZCbBZw4uwWO9pQ%3D%0A)

**Free Version Limitations**
----------------------------

The free version provides access to Wilson's page scanning and AI assistance but has limited functionality.

The following features are not available in the free version:

*   Dashboard
    
*   Analytics
    
*   Surveys
    
*   Screen Recordings
    

These features require a Heatmap account and an active plan.

**Unlocking the Full Experience**
---------------------------------

To access all extension features, click any of the following buttons:

*   **Unlock**
    
*   **Start Free Trial**
    

You'll be prompted to sign up or log in to your Heatmap account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977898/21ef4110e7db6d676a71abe61bc8/94038e60-7504-4bd4-aa79-ae1099e10dba?expires=1789486200&signature=fd806428a3d9a55a86cd67b3ea339b40ec48be20236ae21e3378b90250a659ba&req=diUjEcB5molWUfMW1HO4zamKFgtW2JnA1z8eGZeyNCu3eHYC19oFCKClDrWt%0AtlJLDp2uw0Bl5mToZ80%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977898/21ef4110e7db6d676a71abe61bc8/94038e60-7504-4bd4-aa79-ae1099e10dba?expires=1789486200&signature=fd806428a3d9a55a86cd67b3ea339b40ec48be20236ae21e3378b90250a659ba&req=diUjEcB5molWUfMW1HO4zamKFgtW2JnA1z8eGZeyNCu3eHYC19oFCKClDrWt%0AtlJLDp2uw0Bl5mToZ80%3D%0A)

**Paid Version Guide**
======================

**Getting Started**
-------------------

1.  Launch the **Heatmap Chrome Extension**.
    
2.  Log in to your **Heatmap** account.
    
3.  Once logged in, you'll have full access to all extension features and your Heatmap data.
    
4.  Click the **Menu** icon to navigate through the available features:
    

*   Dashboard
    
*   Analytics
    
*   Funnels
    
*   Heatmaps
    
*   Journey Analysis
    
*   Recordings
    
*   Surveys
    
*   Education
    
*   Settings
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977910/57f658f782b82b128e94181b54bc/f01754f7-a480-4986-aa2f-d81d3ceccb85?expires=1789486200&signature=539c611b80a7cd65bb9dac87ee0faa78aa7ee044ce367f368fc968f597ed293d&req=diUjEcB5moheWfMW1HO4zer85oNxF9May5QclXUjJEe%2FyVOfpzthJIkt0F6I%0AFC29y9BGk7rMdm1o%2FLU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977910/57f658f782b82b128e94181b54bc/f01754f7-a480-4986-aa2f-d81d3ceccb85?expires=1789486200&signature=539c611b80a7cd65bb9dac87ee0faa78aa7ee044ce367f368fc968f597ed293d&req=diUjEcB5moheWfMW1HO4zer85oNxF9May5QclXUjJEe%2FyVOfpzthJIkt0F6I%0AFC29y9BGk7rMdm1o%2FLU%3D%0A)

_The full feature menu, unlocked after logging in._

**How to Use Them**
-------------------

1.  Click any feature you'd like to explore (for example, **Dashboard**).
    
2.  The selected page will populate with your website's data, metrics, and performance trends.
    
3.  Review the available insights and analyze your website's performance.
    
4.  Use the available **filters** and **date range** options to customize your analysis.
    
5.  Click **Pin to Chat** to ask Wilson for additional insights or explanations about any trends or metrics displayed.
    
6.  Click **Go to Heatmap** to open the full Heatmap platform for more advanced reporting and analysis.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977913/b71a128b007f9633add2efd04b78/73d64f22-dd1a-4a04-ab4c-6856bdccb595?expires=1789486200&signature=f708bbc4ff7f01b881eda7b1c1cf9bc2809134125932d0c3573e6779b227d4f4&req=diUjEcB5moheWvMW1HO4zW3NxmluT7tkPqFPSKMn%2Fym556eO9bzToUAqKhmd%0AXR9DqwaB%2BUWfT1SJgJQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977913/b71a128b007f9633add2efd04b78/73d64f22-dd1a-4a04-ab4c-6856bdccb595?expires=1789486200&signature=f708bbc4ff7f01b881eda7b1c1cf9bc2809134125932d0c3573e6779b227d4f4&req=diUjEcB5moheWvMW1HO4zW3NxmluT7tkPqFPSKMn%2Fym556eO9bzToUAqKhmd%0AXR9DqwaB%2BUWfT1SJgJQ%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977911/788e5c5e9e37c214c9949d95fcc8/d6c9e79c-fde5-48aa-9914-7f4c01527248?expires=1789486200&signature=6935d494db21d992028f09b4690e2f0477f10ce46802023092ba0d229b2a9fba&req=diUjEcB5moheWPMW1HO4zb0AQUk9%2F29oq6eYaO4XCKWrAuPdwIci5VK2DWdV%0AznUtSQ486OGO5Er0UJg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977911/788e5c5e9e37c214c9949d95fcc8/d6c9e79c-fde5-48aa-9914-7f4c01527248?expires=1789486200&signature=6935d494db21d992028f09b4690e2f0477f10ce46802023092ba0d229b2a9fba&req=diUjEcB5moheWPMW1HO4zb0AQUk9%2F29oq6eYaO4XCKWrAuPdwIci5VK2DWdV%0AznUtSQ486OGO5Er0UJg%3D%0A)

_The Dashboard surfaces alerts, trends, and one-click access to Wilson for deeper analysis._

**Using the Heatmap**
---------------------

Within the Heatmap feature, you can:

*   View **Click Maps** to understand where visitors interact most.
    
*   View **Scroll Maps** to see how far visitors scroll on your pages.
    
*   Switch between **Interactive Mode** and **Data Mode**.
    
*   Analyze visitor behaviour across different device types.
    
*   Filter data using **Groups**.
    
*   Navigate between different website pages.
    
*   Analyze individual page elements for clicks, revenue, and user engagement.
    

For a more comprehensive analysis, click Go to Heatmap to access the full Heatmap platform.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977908/8a2d993957781f15fee2ebf27514/f4b38268-55d1-4a7d-82bd-13e8b0355896?expires=1789486200&signature=183be9654a78a140e0259b60dd7167f6ef4fc5040ed495781005980e85d1e979&req=diUjEcB5mohfUfMW1HO4zQe3lxbU3XQ9mQ5ogRBFUdmYsdixkkXDLH4FqnyK%0AjdcwS4fYTLJm8LGJs64%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2547977908/8a2d993957781f15fee2ebf27514/f4b38268-55d1-4a7d-82bd-13e8b0355896?expires=1789486200&signature=183be9654a78a140e0259b60dd7167f6ef4fc5040ed495781005980e85d1e979&req=diUjEcB5mohfUfMW1HO4zQe3lxbU3XQ9mQ5ogRBFUdmYsdixkkXDLH4FqnyK%0AjdcwS4fYTLJm8LGJs64%3D%0A)

_Real, element-level data — clicks, RPC, RPS, AOV, scroll depth, and revenue by page element._

**Go to Heatmap**
-----------------

The Go to Heatmap button redirects you to the Heatmap platform, where you can:

*   Access your complete dashboard.
    
*   View advanced analytics and reports.
    
*   Analyze Heatmaps in greater detail.
    
*   Manage Surveys and Recordings.
    
*   Review Journey Analysis and Funnels.
    
*   Configure tracking settings.
    
*   Access additional tools and account settings.
    

**Tips for Best Results**
-------------------------

*   Run a new page scan after making significant changes to your website.
    
*   Review Heatmaps regularly to identify optimization opportunities.
    
*   Use **Journey Analysis** and **Funnels** together to understand where visitors drop off.
    
*   Watch **Screen Recordings** to gain deeper insights into visitor behaviour.
    
*   Ask Wilson specific questions to receive personalized, actionable recommendations.
    
*   Use filters and date ranges to compare performance over time.
    
*   Visit the full Heatmap platform for advanced reporting and account management.

**Need Help?**
==============

If you have questions or run into any issues while using Heatmap, our support team is here to help. Contact us anytime at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)

# Understanding Revenue Heatmaps: Visualizing Your Profit Centers | Heatmap Help Center

[Skip to main content](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10022282-understanding-revenue-heatmaps-visualizing-your-profit-centers#main-content)

Understanding Revenue Heatmaps: Visualizing Your Profit Centers
===============================================================

Revenue heatmaps, website optimization, purchase count, total revenue, conversion rate, revenue per click, A/B testing, data visualization

October 21, 2024

**Understanding Revenue Heatmaps: Visualizing Your Profit Centers**

Revenue heatmaps are powerful tools that provide a visual representation of how different elements on your website contribute to your bottom line. Unlike traditional heatmaps that only show user interactions, revenue heatmaps link these interactions directly to financial outcomes.

**What are Revenue Heatmaps?**

Revenue heatmaps are advanced analytics visualizations that overlay revenue data on your website's layout. They show not just where users are clicking, but how much revenue those clicks are generating. This allows you to identify which elements of your site are most effective at driving sales and which may need optimization.

**What Do Revenue Heatmaps Look Like?**

A revenue heatmap looks similar to a standard click heatmap, with some key differences:

1.  Hover Overlay: Revenue heatmaps include actual dollar amounts overlaid on the elements, giving you precise figures for each clickable area.
    

1.  Multiple Metrics: You might see revenue related data in the data window presented when you click on an element:
    

\- Purchase Count

\- Total Revenue

\- Average Order Value

\- Conversion Rate

\- Revenue Per Click

\- Revenue Per Session

1.  Time-based Views: Heatmap.com allows you to view data over different time periods, helping you track changes in revenue patterns.
    

**How to Read a Revenue Heatmap**

1.  Identify Hotspots: Look for the brightest or warmest colored areas. These represent your highest revenue-generating elements.
    
2.  Compare Elements: Notice how different buttons, links, or product images compare in terms of revenue generation.
    
3.  Check Underperformers: Pay attention to clickable elements with cooler colors or lower numbers. These might be areas for improvement.
    
4.  Analyze Patterns: Look for any unexpected patterns. Are certain types of elements (e.g., image links vs. text links) consistently performing better?
    

**Using Revenue Heatmaps for Optimization**

\- Prioritize high-revenue areas for A/B testing

\- Reposition underperforming elements to more prominent locations

\- Identify and replicate successful elements across your site

\- Make informed decisions about which products or services to feature more prominently

Need help interpreting your revenue heatmaps? Contact our support team for personalized assistance!

**Welcome to Heatmap**
======================

We’re excited to help you unlock powerful insights about your visitors and turn them into actions that drive revenue.

Heatmap is the world’s first revenue-based heatmap tool, built to show you the complete story of your customers from the moment they land on your site to the point they convert. You’ll see which traffic sources bring in valuable visitors, how people interact with your pages, where they drop off, and which elements actually lead to revenue.

With our features Analytics, Funnels, Heatmaps, Recordings, and Surveys, Heatmap transforms raw behavior into actionable insights. Instead of relying on guesswork, you’ll have clear, revenue-backed data to guide smarter decisions, optimize the customer journey, and grow your business faster.

This guide will walk you through setup, help you interpret your data, and get you to your first quick wins 🚀.

**What to Expect**
------------------

Getting started with Heatmap is fast and easy. When you sign up for Heatmap, you’ll unlock the full behavioral analytics suite and start uncovering insights right away. Here’s how your journey will look:

1.  **Setup (just a few minutes):** Install your Heatmap scripts using our [installation guides](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/collections/13751320-getting-started-installation)
    . Once installed, we'll start tracking your site data 😎.
    
2.  **Day 1-3:** Data begins flowing in as we start tracking your visitors’ behavior. This is the “warm-up” phase.
    
3.  **Day 7:** AI insights unlock, giving you quick, best-practice recommendations to spot your first wins.
    
4.  **Day 10:** Funnel analysis gets richer, showing you exactly where customers drop off and where revenue may be leaking.
    
5.  **Unlocking Continuous Insights:** With full access to analytics, heatmaps, funnels, recordings, AI insights, surveys, and more, you’ll unlock a steady stream of actionable data to optimize your site, boost conversions, and drive revenue growth.
    

* * *

**Install Heatmap in Under 5 Minutes**
======================================

Getting Heatmap up and running only takes a few minutes. Once installed, we’ll start tracking your data to find those wins.

**Quick Setup Steps**
---------------------

1.  **Grab your script:** Find your Heatmap tracking script inside your Heatmap dashboard. Please note that you may have to install two scripts depending on your CMS (ie: Shopify will have two scripts for you to install).
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705656978/e40dcdc8fa7215a5cc46efbb0423/Screenshot+2025-09-02+at+2_00_18%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a0e514b6e9dcf927942592db659608ec9d85575552b8a7c2a4c9f5e684a22c3c&req=dScnE897m4hYUfMW1HO4zZdRDMel%2FHm6B%2FHlB0UzscRB5upWXUXBG%2BaBnAOM%0ALUzb%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705656978/e40dcdc8fa7215a5cc46efbb0423/Screenshot+2025-09-02+at+2_00_18%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=a0e514b6e9dcf927942592db659608ec9d85575552b8a7c2a4c9f5e684a22c3c&req=dScnE897m4hYUfMW1HO4zZdRDMel%2FHm6B%2FHlB0UzscRB5upWXUXBG%2BaBnAOM%0ALUzb%0A)
    
2.  **Install it:** Most heatmap scripts need to be pasted into your site’s `<head>` tag. For your specific CMS, be sure to follow our installation guides and installation video linked in your Heatmap portal. Our guides are also available in our Knowledge Center linked [here](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/collections/13751320-getting-started-installation)
    .
    
3.  **Verify your installation:** Use the “Verify My Snippet” button in your Heatmap dashboard to confirm installation. We’ll be able to identify if the script was installed.
    

That’s it, you’re live! Within 24-48 hours, you’ll see data starting to flow into your account.

**💡 Pro tip:** If data doesn’t show right away, confirm all required snippets are installed (some CMSs use two). The Tracking Code should go first in the site `<head>`. After setup, give it 24–48 hours. Data will start tracking from the moment the script is installed; earlier visits can’t be recovered.

If you run into any specific issues, please contact our customer support team through the support chat, by scheduling a quick onboarding call, or by emailing us anytime at [support@heatmap.com](mailto:support@heatmap.com)
. We’re here to help!

* * *

**Understanding Key Features**
==============================

Once you’re set up, Heatmap gives you access to a full suite of behavioral analytics tools designed to show you the real story behind your visitors’ actions.

Here’s what you’ll find inside:

### **Web Analytics**

Our analytics gives you a clean, revenue-first view of how real shoppers behave on your site: no bots, no instant bounces, no vanity metrics. Instead of inflated numbers, you’ll see heatmap-defined engaged sessions, conversion rate, average order value, and revenue per session (your north-star metric). You can quickly identify which pages, landing pages, traffic sources, devices, or even browsers drive the most value.

[Learn More about Web Analytics](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11526218-user-guide-web-analytics)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705548902/84589d4e0ad67025e8c0b73e2bc0/Analytics_Page+URL.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=bbc4d2f38aceb605453e62dae8838c0b76299e733108550a5f699e4e9a4c3ccc&req=dScnE8x6lYhfW%2FMW1HO4zb9lSeTf6SjhFSX3ZRMUQEVuapXHOh6cO5eROFvQ%0Aipsg%2FwtRLxmq54ixcnQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705548902/84589d4e0ad67025e8c0b73e2bc0/Analytics_Page+URL.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=bbc4d2f38aceb605453e62dae8838c0b76299e733108550a5f699e4e9a4c3ccc&req=dScnE8x6lYhfW%2FMW1HO4zb9lSeTf6SjhFSX3ZRMUQEVuapXHOh6cO5eROFvQ%0Aipsg%2FwtRLxmq54ixcnQ%3D%0A)

### **Funnels**

Map and visualize the customer journey step by step from landing on your site to completing a purchase, so you can clearly see where visitors drop off and where revenue leaks occur. You can view default purchase and cart abandonment funnels, or create custom funnels around specific pages, products or campaigns. Reports show how many users advance versus abandon at each step, making it easy to identify friction points and uncover opportunities for A/B tests or UX improvements. By continuously reviewing and refining your funnels, you’ll focus your optimization efforts where they can have the biggest impact on conversion rates and revenue growth.

[Learn More about Funnels](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11366461-user-guide-funnels)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705549090/42549a112dba4ecfc6de2c5bf7a5/Funnels-GIF_REV+%281%29.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=8d5806f476f1d4b721ce24a7d79e91a6ed0257d817303a2bd1456248761b46e5&req=dScnE8x6lIFWWfMW1HO4zXyysQ8funZru9hu6K1NXQ846aPe6nhA%2Bp9wr95O%0AgkT53v%2FYSGICjO%2BmDP8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705549090/42549a112dba4ecfc6de2c5bf7a5/Funnels-GIF_REV+%281%29.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=8d5806f476f1d4b721ce24a7d79e91a6ed0257d817303a2bd1456248761b46e5&req=dScnE8x6lIFWWfMW1HO4zXyysQ8funZru9hu6K1NXQ846aPe6nhA%2Bp9wr95O%0AgkT53v%2FYSGICjO%2BmDP8%3D%0A)

### **Heatmaps**

Visualize exactly where users click, scroll, and engage on your site layered with revenue data so you can see which actions truly drive sales and which elements may be costing you money. With scrollmaps, you can measure how far visitors actually make it down the page, while the Data Table gives you detailed metrics like Revenue per Click, Revenue per Session, and element-level conversion rates to pinpoint what’s working (and what isn’t). Use Interactive Mode to capture insights from dynamic elements like pop-ups, dropdowns, and hidden menus, so you never miss what’s happening in the spaces traditional heatmaps overlook. You can also apply filters to explore behavior across different user segments, compare page groups, and tap into weekly AI Recommendations to identify quick, revenue-driving opportunities.

[Learn More about Heatmaps](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11690558-user-guide-heatmaps)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705551221/1e3d97ac8bb1b0c42df8eeb4b734/Heatmaps.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=ab0baa1115211a435304890466cfabe791d73ae7bcd443b1eebd7101f9e1a709&req=dScnE8x7nINdWPMW1HO4zaz0GZSz63RQt3S5NkR1hzzyFI67cg1xwW5StWP8%0AFqEScju8gep4sXCKQ%2Bc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705551221/1e3d97ac8bb1b0c42df8eeb4b734/Heatmaps.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=ab0baa1115211a435304890466cfabe791d73ae7bcd443b1eebd7101f9e1a709&req=dScnE8x7nINdWPMW1HO4zaz0GZSz63RQt3S5NkR1hzzyFI67cg1xwW5StWP8%0AFqEScju8gep4sXCKQ%2Bc%3D%0A)

### **HeatmapAI Recommendations**

HeatmapAI delivers weekly, AI-powered recommendations that combine your site’s behavioral and revenue data with CRO best practices to highlight the biggest opportunities for improvement. On the dashboard, you’ll see performance trends and top-level insights, while each Heatmap page provides up to 10 page-specific suggestions on design, layout, and calls-to-action that could boost Revenue Per Session (RPS). AI also analyzes survey responses, clustering feedback into clear themes so you can quickly understand what customers are saying at scale. These insights give you a practical, prioritized roadmap for optimization, helping you focus your efforts where they’ll have the most impact.

[Learn More about HeatmapAI](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12099444-heatmapai-insights)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705555686/9d07c8c9022f265ed28fe01b7f52/AI+Insights.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=d8f9b4c53e22c6e878b6afbe5c85e3cb02bab7f4f3051472da1d259bc4c45203&req=dScnE8x7mIdXX%2FMW1HO4zSb3lOARiKOWiHRWvFXr5mIQXvZsANtdmF2sNHV6%0AGPDeDkaE7pVZIdZ42YU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705555686/9d07c8c9022f265ed28fe01b7f52/AI+Insights.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=d8f9b4c53e22c6e878b6afbe5c85e3cb02bab7f4f3051472da1d259bc4c45203&req=dScnE8x7mIdXX%2FMW1HO4zSb3lOARiKOWiHRWvFXr5mIQXvZsANtdmF2sNHV6%0AGPDeDkaE7pVZIdZ42YU%3D%0A)

### **Filters for User Cohorts**

Filters in Heatmap let you zero in on specific user groups or behaviors so you can uncover more actionable insights. You’ll have access to pre-built filters like Entry Page, Traffic Source, Ads Platform, Viewed Page, New vs. Returning Users, Rage Clicks, Purchasers, Non-purchasers, and Average Order Value, plus the ability to create unlimited Custom Filters tailored to your needs. Filters work across multiple features like Analytics, Funnels, Heatmaps, and Recordings, making it easy to analyze how different audiences engage with your site, where they drop off, and how they respond to experiments. You can even use Comparison Mode in Heatmaps to view two segments side by side, helping you spot key differences in engagement and identify the most impactful optimization opportunities.

[Learn More about Filters](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10508265-heatmap-filters-for-user-cohorts-segmentation)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705556242/9ad2d4304b1d009abc1673e5b383/Filters.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=d8ec824e6077417aaac8f481cf6e59849f5f9a733fda2aa6321048cb4136a924&req=dScnE8x7m4NbW%2FMW1HO4zcT4kGdlEvSwiXf4XcqWa7%2BbT1rMqgcMMTyqZgXP%0AH%2FmHZADwoUBjwN%2Bh6Rs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705556242/9ad2d4304b1d009abc1673e5b383/Filters.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=d8ec824e6077417aaac8f481cf6e59849f5f9a733fda2aa6321048cb4136a924&req=dScnE8x7m4NbW%2FMW1HO4zcT4kGdlEvSwiXf4XcqWa7%2BbT1rMqgcMMTyqZgXP%0AH%2FmHZADwoUBjwN%2Bh6Rs%3D%0A)

### **Screen Recordings**

Watch real user sessions as visitors move through your site, capturing clicks, scrolls, mouse movements, and hesitations to reveal the why behind the data. Recordings provide full context showing where users get stuck, what they ignore, and where friction leads to drop-offs. You can filter sessions by factors like purchase value, device, or browser, then replay journeys to spot confusing navigation paths, missed CTAs, or technical issues. This feature is invaluable for troubleshooting performance drops, validating A/B test results, and understanding how design changes impact the customer experience.

[Learn More about Screen Recordings](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11690535-user-guide-recordings)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705559796/691b68339a0bf9e27a801e5e8bb1/Screenrecording.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=94ebd883144f2955fcca7cb1aeb12bdb25804305f4ac9020ec7c47dd7eff4e5e&req=dScnE8x7lIZWX%2FMW1HO4za6vjPnGz5qHTWszsTjGi7xYBI1AbE%2BfGdKHrc9y%0AXYfEtVxrkUw1HTKZSMc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705559796/691b68339a0bf9e27a801e5e8bb1/Screenrecording.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=94ebd883144f2955fcca7cb1aeb12bdb25804305f4ac9020ec7c47dd7eff4e5e&req=dScnE8x7lIZWX%2FMW1HO4za6vjPnGz5qHTWszsTjGi7xYBI1AbE%2BfGdKHrc9y%0AXYfEtVxrkUw1HTKZSMc%3D%0A)

### **A/B Testing Integrations**

A/B Test Filters in Heatmap let you analyze both live and completed experiments to see exactly how users interacted with different page variants. You can integrate supported A/B testing platforms like Shoplift, Visually, or Intelligems, then pull in specific experiments or variants to compare clicks, scroll depth, revenue, and engagement at the element level. For live tests, data updates as it runs, while for ended tests, you can use the date filter and View Previous Versions to revisit historical performance. This makes it easy to identify winning variations, learn from what didn’t work, and confidently apply those insights to future optimizations.

[Learn More about A/B Test Filters](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/10572363-a-b-test-filters)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705560954/8aae6a301b3e81717d28d953d088/AB+Testing.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=7221d117ef2e325c1cedbf25c0feed92d0e9b7236e7af318087ced46b3aa7a2a&req=dScnE8x4nYhaXfMW1HO4zXB64C%2Bm6Vf%2FAjXDs0lYI1FDnRhhxAMqxflW%2Fwb0%0AEbaWHxFLOQ2twss9eTA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705560954/8aae6a301b3e81717d28d953d088/AB+Testing.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=7221d117ef2e325c1cedbf25c0feed92d0e9b7236e7af318087ced46b3aa7a2a&req=dScnE8x4nYhaXfMW1HO4zXB64C%2Bm6Vf%2FAjXDs0lYI1FDnRhhxAMqxflW%2Fwb0%0AEbaWHxFLOQ2twss9eTA%3D%0A)

### **Surveys**

Gather direct feedback from your customers to better understand their needs, frustrations, and motivations. Those insights can form stronger messaging, design, and site offers. You can build and launch branded surveys in minutes using a simple drag-and-drop editor, with flexible question types like Short Answer, Paragraph, Checkboxes, Single Choice, and Rating Scales. Once responses start coming in, HeatmapAI automatically analyzes open-ended feedback to surface themes and customer language, so you can quickly spot patterns without sifting through every response. The result: clearer messaging, more relevant visuals, stronger value propositions, and a site experience that truly resonates with your audience.

[Learn More about Surveys](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11106228-user-guide-customer-feedback-surveys)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705561255/067b89ff0793bba11d6ca1179915/Survey.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=db7dd21483f782d88e212fd71bd5a89116f6e954a6036d21aa68319afbbe5d21&req=dScnE8x4nINaXPMW1HO4zZmOC4FDkFIBLXFUns0fDc8E5rBJjymcyObaOxVk%0AHk871hIWUiHKoHI%2F8L0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1705561255/067b89ff0793bba11d6ca1179915/Survey.gif?expires=1789486200&signature=db7dd21483f782d88e212fd71bd5a89116f6e954a6036d21aa68319afbbe5d21&req=dScnE8x4nINaXPMW1HO4zZmOC4FDkFIBLXFUns0fDc8E5rBJjymcyObaOxVk%0AHk871hIWUiHKoHI%2F8L0%3D%0A)

**Where to Start with Heatmap**
===============================

Getting started with Heatmap doesn’t have to feel overwhelming. Here’s a simple sequence to follow so you can uncover meaningful insights quickly and start making impactful changes:

1.  ### **Begin with the Main Dashboard**
    
    Start each session here to get a high-level snapshot of performance. The dashboard shows top trends, key KPIs, and AI Insights that surface opportunities you might otherwise miss. This is your “command center” for deciding where to dig in first.
    
    _Example:_ You notice RPS and Conversion Rate are slightly down compared to the previous period. Use this as a signal to dig deeper into Analytics.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699810894/7094bd6a1f9c089ac19ebc2cb9e1/AD_4nXeRqU62odk--RrtROCAqvlKc0-m6v-ndauzLZn8LVMRd6UTWczeWRJ8O8RAV_MR0zwsbaEMx0J5hzAQDl0smaV_vlUDYJYvIyAf26wFrmuSeu2RsVGlxNdSRKf9XxscNyb31lvCXw?expires=1789486200&signature=34015cdca584c246c88471cce7a37a397d8d602fa3f965629eb1ea53e1efeecb&req=dSYuH8F%2FnYlWXfMW1HO4zTcVqhyJKtH658i8jnrTz5vgDvFI0YQQjjalz%2FbQ%0AH%2FJ5%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699810894/7094bd6a1f9c089ac19ebc2cb9e1/AD_4nXeRqU62odk--RrtROCAqvlKc0-m6v-ndauzLZn8LVMRd6UTWczeWRJ8O8RAV_MR0zwsbaEMx0J5hzAQDl0smaV_vlUDYJYvIyAf26wFrmuSeu2RsVGlxNdSRKf9XxscNyb31lvCXw?expires=1789486200&signature=34015cdca584c246c88471cce7a37a397d8d602fa3f965629eb1ea53e1efeecb&req=dSYuH8F%2FnYlWXfMW1HO4zTcVqhyJKtH658i8jnrTz5vgDvFI0YQQjjalz%2FbQ%0AH%2FJ5%0A)
    
2.  ### **Use Analytics to Review High-Value Pages**
    
    Head into Analytics to see which pages, traffic sources, or devices are driving the most revenue per session (RPS). This helps you focus your time on areas that are already high-value or underperforming relative to their potential.
    
    _Example:_ You notice sessions nearly doubled on some of your top pages, but at the same time overall RPS and Conversion Rate are trending down. This suggests new traffic may be less qualified or those pages aren’t converting at the same rate as before. Head into Funnels to check the health of your overall customer journey and see if there’s particular steps having significant drop-off.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811083/ee723e47e6b98b8efd30e6c7961c/AD_4nXdFOwdMJ0WOznRDRMAc_8P_Iv13XdO9M5J9C0X9Jsrzwk_VsvrqWE4cwAcObGgMZzDoyMK4mRadw3e87IL0OcA4LTicaUDW1wzgtv3FtPXgXGzd65YDEzSHss3JCq3OwFeQliDb?expires=1789486200&signature=438d93a16ed51a3922bce5c446fb47e81467d90806b57db0f5a5902eac5f2e8e&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIFXWvMW1HO4zdkSMyDkYb61bSg%2Fj0kQzw%2FFdF37nTDfMbKvA2PS%0APrwc%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811083/ee723e47e6b98b8efd30e6c7961c/AD_4nXdFOwdMJ0WOznRDRMAc_8P_Iv13XdO9M5J9C0X9Jsrzwk_VsvrqWE4cwAcObGgMZzDoyMK4mRadw3e87IL0OcA4LTicaUDW1wzgtv3FtPXgXGzd65YDEzSHss3JCq3OwFeQliDb?expires=1789486200&signature=438d93a16ed51a3922bce5c446fb47e81467d90806b57db0f5a5902eac5f2e8e&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIFXWvMW1HO4zdkSMyDkYb61bSg%2Fj0kQzw%2FFdF37nTDfMbKvA2PS%0APrwc%0A)
    
3.  ### **Build or Review Funnels to Spot Drop-Offs**
    
    Use Funnels to map the customer journey and identify where visitors abandon the path to purchase. They will highlight your biggest leaks and the highest-impact opportunities for optimization.
    
    _Example:_ You see a significant drop-off between the Product Page and Add to Cart step. This suggests that elements like the buy box or above-the-fold content may not be compelling enough to drive action. Head into Heatmaps or Screen Recordings to analyze those elements and understand what users may not be resonating with.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811631/86ef26ba28a6ea0c5c61a344df8b/AD_4nXfgoNWzmqyy4LjaDcPnAJlcPIy3WKRW_cWBQSzcHSOY5VdeMO09KsXibBUVB9oTIxXg2EKUlh6gtDghyyx-I__kdg6YuFuHUOGHXGVukGU_rz4-PN2Y7fKLkUeuwtHJY3Gg4KyXvA?expires=1789486200&signature=cb384d8f2ba759061587182be6f424ea8b3e135da3bc74cc01850b0a93044836&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIdcWPMW1HO4zS113XCEcVSv%2BVvbaP%2BLcApDmjNK0AXocDM3PI5Y%0ALJ3W%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811631/86ef26ba28a6ea0c5c61a344df8b/AD_4nXfgoNWzmqyy4LjaDcPnAJlcPIy3WKRW_cWBQSzcHSOY5VdeMO09KsXibBUVB9oTIxXg2EKUlh6gtDghyyx-I__kdg6YuFuHUOGHXGVukGU_rz4-PN2Y7fKLkUeuwtHJY3Gg4KyXvA?expires=1789486200&signature=cb384d8f2ba759061587182be6f424ea8b3e135da3bc74cc01850b0a93044836&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIdcWPMW1HO4zS113XCEcVSv%2BVvbaP%2BLcApDmjNK0AXocDM3PI5Y%0ALJ3W%0A)
    
4.  ### **Dig Deeper with Heatmaps & Recordings**
    
    Once you know where drop-offs happen, Heatmaps and Recordings will show you why. Heatmaps reveal which elements drive revenue (not just clicks), while Recordings let you watch real user journeys to uncover friction and hesitations.
    
    _Example:_ Looking at the main product page, we’re seeing that the Add to Cart CTA is getting solid engagement and driving high value, but the product gallery is attracting even more value. This could suggest that visitors want to better understand the product before committing and taking the next step (ie: purse size, product materials, etc). Creating an A/B testing roadmap to improve elements on the page could validate these insights.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811958/9a60eeb5ce3cce8a5685bf7e65dc/AD_4nXf7PKh9hR3AU6NHzY3jym941S5ebyfAAbQz3doiHahFdZk3pdXwkfQTxGXGRgsSB6BEObbg7A93szrKRZV_0w1JBLLF3qKzN3_V0ARAx7nE3HO3G9j8mCUUg3sleqoyXWXX0eJb?expires=1789486200&signature=403d7d3ad20ed3df21f2734eda890ca2f6e88be1e6b1a3fc1ef76881b9126893&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIhaUfMW1HO4zfziYzpoQSM86tIfBNiPp%2BQjnT%2BzyCGclsZi2q%2FX%0A1Mun%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699811958/9a60eeb5ce3cce8a5685bf7e65dc/AD_4nXf7PKh9hR3AU6NHzY3jym941S5ebyfAAbQz3doiHahFdZk3pdXwkfQTxGXGRgsSB6BEObbg7A93szrKRZV_0w1JBLLF3qKzN3_V0ARAx7nE3HO3G9j8mCUUg3sleqoyXWXX0eJb?expires=1789486200&signature=403d7d3ad20ed3df21f2734eda890ca2f6e88be1e6b1a3fc1ef76881b9126893&req=dSYuH8F%2FnIhaUfMW1HO4zfziYzpoQSM86tIfBNiPp%2BQjnT%2BzyCGclsZi2q%2FX%0A1Mun%0A)
    
5.  ### **Test What Matters**
    
    Once you see what’s working (and what’s not), you can prioritize fixes with A/B tests. Focus on changes that move users from one funnel step to the next (like optimizing CTAs or reducing checkout friction). You can then analyze test variants by connecting your A/B testing platform to Heatmap directly to monitor user behavior. This ensures your efforts drive measurable results.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699812387/920e421c43b4f20afa896f9b3691/AD_4nXeQaJMWjVfru2ggvQH9OZQkPCboOrkE2ZUGhYI1I9Y1BFrmNVD3pfmaD3qqXubrZJqTxRooO1g9SmVtDbuKBxXcfb-iY0Jdx_1Szequ0EvB9gAbX7rCyw9wAYjRblFRE_OrC1hWxg?expires=1789486200&signature=4058b4c21c6c869b150992a4e55ba3df06a5a9195959d64d09cdf765b01239b1&req=dSYuH8F%2Fn4JXXvMW1HO4zfXnI%2BgeWMtkNFUXZgSzsfS02GYjR1tyGp5Fp91z%0Akbyx%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1699812387/920e421c43b4f20afa896f9b3691/AD_4nXeQaJMWjVfru2ggvQH9OZQkPCboOrkE2ZUGhYI1I9Y1BFrmNVD3pfmaD3qqXubrZJqTxRooO1g9SmVtDbuKBxXcfb-iY0Jdx_1Szequ0EvB9gAbX7rCyw9wAYjRblFRE_OrC1hWxg?expires=1789486200&signature=4058b4c21c6c869b150992a4e55ba3df06a5a9195959d64d09cdf765b01239b1&req=dSYuH8F%2Fn4JXXvMW1HO4zfXnI%2BgeWMtkNFUXZgSzsfS02GYjR1tyGp5Fp91z%0Akbyx%0A)
    
6.  ### **Keep Improving with Continuous Insights**
    
    Optimization is an ongoing process. Revisit your funnels, dashboards, and heatmaps regularly to track progress. Layer in Surveys to collect direct customer feedback and refine messaging or offers based on what matters most to your visitors.
    
    For more educational content on how to use and maximize Heatmap, reference our [Education Center](https://portal.heatmap.com/education-center)
    .

**Analyzing Heatmap Data**
==========================

Heatmap’s data is designed for one thing: helping you optimize your website for growth. Unlike other analytics platforms built for accounting or broad reporting, Heatmap filters out “junk traffic” (like bots, instant bounces, and non-interactive sessions), so every number you see reflects real shopper behavior. That’s why your data may look different compared to platforms like Shopify or GA4, it’s intentional. We want you to make decisions based on clean, actionable insights that tie directly to conversions and revenue.

**Introducing RPS and RPC as Standard Metrics**
-----------------------------------------------

One of the most unique parts of Heatmap is that we introduce RPS (Revenue per Session) and RPC (Revenue per Click) as standard, primary KPIs. While most analytics tools push CVR (conversion rate) as the key metric, CVR only tells you how many visitors purchased, without showing how much value those visits or clicks actually generated. By focusing on RPS and RPC, Heatmap gives you deeper visibility into what drives real revenue growth.

*   **RPS (Revenue per Session)** - Your north-star metric. RPS measures the average revenue generated per engaged session (Total Revenue ÷ Sessions), giving you a clear picture of overall site health and the true value of your traffic.
    
    **_When to use RPS:_** Track overall performance, compare traffic sources, and measure the impact of site-wide changes. It’s best for holistic analysis, like which pages in Analytics or which areas in Heatmaps are most valuable to visitors. If RPS rises, you’re extracting more value from your traffic.
    

*   **RPC (Revenue per Click)** - The element-level metric. RPC measures the average revenue per click on a specific element (Revenue from an Element ÷ Clicks on that Element), showing you which CTAs, buttons, links, or product tiles actually drive value.
    
    **_When to use RPC:_** Compare elements within a Heatmap to see which content, CTAs, or design features are pulling their weight. This helps you identify which elements deserve more visibility, testing, or refinement.
    

**Why Both RPS and RPC Matter**
-------------------------------

Together, RPS and RPC give you a balanced view: RPS shows the big picture of how effectively your site converts traffic into revenue, while RPC zooms in on the details of how individual elements perform. Unlike CVR, which only measures purchase completion, RPS and RPC connect user behavior directly to revenue impact—making them the most actionable KPIs for website optimization.

### **The Heatmap Data Model**

Heatmap’s data model is intentionally different. We focus only on website-driven performance, filtering out bots, non-interactive sessions, and off-site sales like Shop App, POS, or subscriptions, so your numbers aren’t inflated by irrelevant activity. Our engaged sessions use a simple 5-second rule to capture valid visits, we include shipping and tax in AOV for a truer view of customer spend, and we use privacy-friendly LocalStorage instead of cookies for more reliable tracking. While your numbers won’t always match Shopify or GA4, they’re designed to be cleaner, more actionable, and better aligned with optimization, not accounting.

Read more about our [Data Definitions](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11510254-heatmap-data-definitions-methodology)
, how [Heatmap compares to Shopify](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/11525742-understanding-heatmap-vs-shopify-data)
, and how [Heatmap stacks up against GA4](https://intercom.help/heatmapcom/en/articles/12118640-understanding-heatmap-vs-google-analytics-ga4-data)
.

**General Information**
=======================

**Collect customer feedback fast with AI analysis**
---------------------------------------------------

Heatmap Surveys is a simple yet powerful tool that helps you collect real customer feedback about their experience, your site, and your products, all in just a few clicks.

Whether you're trying to improve your copy, update visuals, or refine your value prop, surveys let you hear directly from the people who matter most: your customers.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1995508517/5ad02a3a274f4c382e894e497faa/eebbe796-bdf4-49e8-8201-901ccf7dc200?expires=1789486200&signature=4fc3f55ae09fcba1d474d34264ced8ec0866212a1c11ca2b70e4016e6d1685b9&req=dSkuE8x%2BlYReXvMW1HO4zRz2iuNfgg3FuXWfEWJ9%2FrIBEEOBu0TyxHh5My8K%0Avcwwjlo5FNLjzpFNgW8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/1995508517/5ad02a3a274f4c382e894e497faa/eebbe796-bdf4-49e8-8201-901ccf7dc200?expires=1789486200&signature=4fc3f55ae09fcba1d474d34264ced8ec0866212a1c11ca2b70e4016e6d1685b9&req=dSkuE8x%2BlYReXvMW1HO4zRz2iuNfgg3FuXWfEWJ9%2FrIBEEOBu0TyxHh5My8K%0Avcwwjlo5FNLjzpFNgW8%3D%0A)

**Why use customer feedback surveys**
-------------------------------------

After gathering a honey-pot of valuable insights after sending your customer feedback surveys, you can:

*   Write copy that actually converts
    

➡️ Learn your customers' exact words to describe their problems, needs, and outcomes. Use those insights to write headlines and product pages that speak their language.

*   Choose images and videos that match customer expectations
    

➡️ Discover what they’re looking for visually, then adjust your graphics, product images, or layout to match.

*   Identify stronger value propositions
    

➡️ Customer responses reveal what they care about most — use that to highlight the benefits that move the needle and drive sales.

This isn’t about making your site prettier. It’s about making it _clearer_, _more relevant_, and _more persuasive_. That’s what moves the needle.

**Understanding Customer Feedback Survey Types**
------------------------------------------------

**Long-Form Surveys**

Long-Form Surveys are sent to customers outside of your website experience. They are best when you want deeper, more reflective feedback from your customers who have already interacted with your brand.

Best For:

*   Post-purchase feedback
    
*   Understanding _why_ someone made a purchase
    
*   Detailed insights on value prop, messaging, and objections
    
*   Multi-question surveys that mix ratings and open-ended responses
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2031867582/34784a31191da0aea46edc094698/Screenshot+2026-02-05+at+11_28_33%E2%80%AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=245f61f8342f41c65ca67bc86e0c1f0d67125b3af05e64e6ce065af6df47237c&req=diAkF8F4moRXW%2FMW1HO4zeBPj55M4lPDVXHwlxCPVBNesXw4j1F05M2HjW2y%0A2B%2BDch%2F5TvWZ81DPKCk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2031867582/34784a31191da0aea46edc094698/Screenshot+2026-02-05+at+11_28_33%E2%80%AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=245f61f8342f41c65ca67bc86e0c1f0d67125b3af05e64e6ce065af6df47237c&req=diAkF8F4moRXW%2FMW1HO4zeBPj55M4lPDVXHwlxCPVBNesXw4j1F05M2HjW2y%0A2B%2BDch%2F5TvWZ81DPKCk%3D%0A)

**Pop-Up Surveys**

Pop-Up surveys appear directly on your website and are designed to be _fast_, asking one question to reduce friction and capture feedback in the moment.

Best For:

*   Capturing “in-the-moment” reactions while someone is browsing
    
*   Quick pulse checks on clarity and intent
    
*   Identifying confusion, objections, or missing information on a specific page
    
*   High-volume directional insights
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2031866725/bb5a600d3a2a033bfab2720b8c29/Screenshot%2B2026-02-05%2Bat%2B11_28_37-E2-80-AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=8b84fff53ba93b478d90017911025fefc016b74924a3486fc4c31791af70c673&req=diAkF8F4m4ZdXPMW1HO4zZF96bpBW%2F7MLCTKMPVbuESn91LTHuhP4U%2B48bJl%0ALMhUTY07ClnUk%2BBGqPU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/zmls3dse/2031866725/bb5a600d3a2a033bfab2720b8c29/Screenshot%2B2026-02-05%2Bat%2B11_28_37-E2-80-AFAM.png?expires=1789486200&signature=8b84fff53ba93b478d90017911025fefc016b74924a3486fc4c31791af70c673&req=diAkF8F4m4ZdXPMW1HO4zZF96bpBW%2F7MLCTKMPVbuESn91LTHuhP4U%2B48bJl%0ALMhUTY07ClnUk%2BBGqPU%3D%0A)

**Let AI do the heavy lifting**
-------------------------------

HeatmapAI automatically analyzes your survey responses to provide actionable insights. Save a few hours of analysis and get _more valuable insights_ than if you did it yourself!

This will help you quickly understand trends and patterns from your customers without manually reviewing every response, especially for Short Answer or Paragraph responses.

* * *

**Getting Started with Pop-Up Customer Feedback Surveys**
=========================================================

**Access and Create Pop-Up Surveys**
------------------------------------

Heatmap Surveys is super simple and easy to use. To create your Pop-Up survey:

1.  Navigate to the Surveys section in your Heatmap dashboard
    
2.  Click "Create New Survey"
    
3.  Select Pop-Up Survey
    
4.  Add your survey name
    
5.  Choose a style for the Pop-Up Survey by choosing from the following:
    
    *   Window - a small window in the bottom corner of your page

**💡Pro Tips: Survey Best Practices**
-------------------------------------

*   Keep it simple. Use one clear question to make responses fast. Single Choice or Rating Scale works best for Pop-Up surveys.
    
*   Match the survey style to the effort you’re asking for.
    
    *   Bubble: best for lightweight feedback
        
    *   Window: great for quick brand, product, or experience questions
        
    *   Full Pop Up: use sparingly, reserve for high-value moments
        
    
*   Be mindful of the survey trigger.
    
    *   Immediately after load: only for super quick responses
        
    *   Time delay: best for “first impression” feedback
        
    *   Scroll %: great for engaged visitors on landing pages
        
    *   Exit intent: best for “What stopped you?” moments
        
    
*   Use “How” or “What,” not “Why.” “Why” can feel confrontational and may reduce response rates.

**Survey Publishing & Sharing**
-------------------------------

**Publish your Heatmap Pop-Up Survey**
--------------------------------------

After creating your survey, it’s simple to publish on your website:

1.  Go to the Surveys section
    
2.  Click the 3 vertical dots icon to publish or unpublish the desired survey
    
3.  The survey will start running on your website. Note that only one Pop-Up Survey can run on your website at a time.
    

That’s it! Now you’re ready to start collecting insights.

* * *

**Managing Surveys**
--------------------

**Viewing Survey Responses**
----------------------------

Once your survey is live, you’ll start seeing responses within minutes. To check results:

1.  Go to the Surveys section
    
2.  Select the survey you want to view
    
3.  Click the Responses tab
    

Here, you'll find the answers to your survey question.

You’ll also get survey performance analytics, including:

*   Total Impressions
    
*   Surveys Started
    
*   Abandoned Surveys
    
*   Completed Surveys

**💡Pro Tips: Survey Best Practices**
-------------------------------------

*   Use 6-8 Questions Max in Long-Form Surveys to not overwhelm customers.
    
*   Use “How” or “What” Questions instead of “Why.” It makes people defensive subconsciously and less likely to answer.
    
*   Keep questions customer-focused! Your goal is to get to know them better.

**Survey Publishing & Sharing**

**Share Your Heatmap Survey**
-----------------------------

After creating your survey, it’s simple to publish, share, and start collecting results. To share your survey:

1.  Go to the Surveys section
    
2.  Select the survey you want to share
    
3.  Click Copy Link
    
4.  Paste and share the link via email or social channels
    

That’s it! Now you’re ready to start collecting insights.
